SELECT
  ssc.SCHOOL_CODE AS school_code,
  ssc.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name,
  sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME AS department_full_name,
  scd.COURSE_LEVEL AS course_level,
  COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE) AS total_number_of_courses,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' THEN scd.COURSE END) AS total_number_of_degree_granting_courses
FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd
JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd
  ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT
JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc
  ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE
GROUP BY
  ssc.SCHOOL_CODE,
  ssc.SCHOOL_NAME,
  sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME,
  scd.COURSE_LEVEL;

WITH base AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    sc.SCHOOL_CODE,
    sc.SCHOOL_NAME,
    d.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER,
    cd.COURSE_LEVEL
  FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc
  JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION cd
    ON cd.COURSE = sc.SUBJECT_CODE
  JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d
    ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = cd.DEPARTMENT
  JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad
    ON ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE
),
phone_counts AS (
  SELECT
    SCHOOL_CODE,
    SCHOOL_NAME,
    DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    COUNT(DISTINCT DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER) AS total_phone_numbers
  FROM base
  WHERE DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER IS NOT NULL AND DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER <> ''
  GROUP BY SCHOOL_CODE, SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME
),
level_counts AS (
  SELECT
    SCHOOL_CODE,
    SCHOOL_NAME,
    DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    COURSE_LEVEL,
    COUNT(*) AS lvl_cnt
  FROM base
  WHERE COURSE_LEVEL IS NOT NULL AND COURSE_LEVEL <> ''
  GROUP BY SCHOOL_CODE, SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, COURSE_LEVEL
),
level_ranked AS (
  SELECT
    lc.*,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY SCHOOL_CODE, SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME
      ORDER BY lvl_cnt DESC, COURSE_LEVEL
    ) AS rn
  FROM level_counts lc
)
SELECT
  pc.SCHOOL_CODE,
  pc.SCHOOL_NAME,
  pc.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
  pc.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  pc.total_phone_numbers,
  lr.COURSE_LEVEL AS most_common_course_level
FROM phone_counts pc
LEFT JOIN level_ranked lr
  ON lr.SCHOOL_CODE = pc.SCHOOL_CODE
 AND lr.SCHOOL_NAME = pc.SCHOOL_NAME
 AND lr.DEPARTMENT_CODE = pc.DEPARTMENT_CODE
 AND lr.DEPARTMENT_NAME = pc.DEPARTMENT_NAME
 AND lr.rn = 1
ORDER BY
  pc.SCHOOL_CODE,
  pc.DEPARTMENT_CODE;

SELECT
  ssc.SCHOOL_CODE AS school_code,
  ssc.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name,
  sd.DLC_KEY AS dlc_key,
  scd.GRADUATE_LEVEL AS graduate_level,
  COUNT(DISTINCT ssc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS total_sis_subjects,
  MIN(ssc.COURSE_NUMBER) AS min_course_number,
  MAX(ssc.COURSE_NUMBER) AS max_course_number,
  COUNT(DISTINCT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS total_departments_offering_subjects
FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc
JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd
  ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE
JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd
  ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE
GROUP BY
  ssc.SCHOOL_CODE,
  ssc.SCHOOL_NAME,
  sd.DLC_KEY,
  scd.GRADUATE_LEVEL
ORDER BY
  ssc.SCHOOL_CODE,
  sd.DLC_KEY,
  scd.GRADUATE_LEVEL;

SELECT
  sd.BUILDING_COMPONENT AS building_component,
  b.BUILDING_NAME AS building_name,
  SUM(sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS total_room_square_footage,
  COUNT(DISTINCT sd.FLOOR_KEY) AS total_number_of_floors,
  COUNT(DISTINCT sd.BUILDING_ROOM) AS total_number_of_rooms,
  COUNT(DISTINCT su.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS total_number_of_facility_organizations,
  COUNT(DISTINCT ssu.MIT_ID) AS total_number_of_supervisors,
  COALESCE(SUM(DISTINCT ssu.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES), 0) AS total_number_of_supervisees
FROM SPACE_DETAIL sd
JOIN BUILDINGS b
  ON b.BUILDING_KEY = sd.BUILDING_KEY
LEFT JOIN SPACE_UNIT su
  ON su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = sd.SPACE_UNIT_KEY
LEFT JOIN SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE ssu
  ON ssu.DEPT_NAMES = su.DLC_KEY
GROUP BY
  sd.BUILDING_COMPONENT,
  b.BUILDING_NAME
ORDER BY
  sd.BUILDING_COMPONENT,
  b.BUILDING_NAME;

WITH
dlc_base AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    su.DLC_KEY,
    fo.DLC_NAME
  FROM SPACE_UNIT su
  LEFT JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo
    ON fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = su.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY
),
space_agg AS (
  SELECT
    su.DLC_KEY,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sd.FLOOR_KEY) AS total_floors,
    SUM(sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS total_square_footage,
    COUNT(DISTINCT su.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS total_facility_organizations,
    SUM(CASE WHEN fb.BUILDING_HEIGHT IS NULL OR TRIM(fb.BUILDING_HEIGHT) = '' THEN 0 ELSE CAST(fb.BUILDING_HEIGHT AS DECIMAL(18,2)) END) AS total_building_heights
  FROM SPACE_UNIT su
  JOIN SPACE_DETAIL sd
    ON sd.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY
  LEFT JOIN FCLT_BUILDING fb
    ON fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = sd.BUILDING_KEY
  GROUP BY su.DLC_KEY
),
supervisor_agg AS (
  SELECT
    ssu.DEPT_NAMES AS DLC_KEY,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ssu.MIT_ID) AS total_supervisors,
    SUM(ssu.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES) AS total_supervisees
  FROM SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE ssu
  GROUP BY ssu.DEPT_NAMES
)
SELECT
  db.DLC_KEY AS dlc_key,
  db.DLC_NAME AS dlc_name,
  COALESCE(sa.total_floors, 0) AS total_number_of_floors,
  COALESCE(sa.total_square_footage, 0) AS total_square_footage,
  COALESCE(sa.total_facility_organizations, 0) AS total_number_of_facility_organizations,
  COALESCE(sva.total_supervisors, 0) AS total_number_of_supervisors,
  COALESCE(sva.total_supervisees, 0) AS total_number_of_supervisees,
  COALESCE(sa.total_building_heights, 0) AS total_building_heights
FROM dlc_base db
LEFT JOIN space_agg sa
  ON sa.DLC_KEY = db.DLC_KEY
LEFT JOIN supervisor_agg sva
  ON sva.DLC_KEY = db.DLC_KEY
ORDER BY db.DLC_KEY;

SELECT
  tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS total_tip_subject_types,
  SUM(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students,
  MIN(tm.RENTAL_NEW_PRICE) AS min_rental_new_price,
  MAX(tm.RENTAL_NEW_PRICE) AS max_rental_new_price
FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso
LEFT JOIN TIP_DETAIL td
  ON td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
LEFT JOIN TIP_MATERIAL tm
  ON tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME
ORDER BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME;

SELECT
  c.ACADEMIC_YEAR,
  c.TERM_CODE,
  s.HGN_CODE,
  COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS total_course_types,
  AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units,
  c.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  e.FULL_NAME AS person_in_charge_name,
  e.EMAIL_ADDRESS AS person_in_charge_email
FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS t
JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c
  ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE
JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED s
  ON s.SUBJECT_ID = c.SUBJECT_ID
LEFT JOIN EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY e
  ON e.MIT_ID = s.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID
WHERE t.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y'
GROUP BY
  c.ACADEMIC_YEAR,
  c.TERM_CODE,
  s.HGN_CODE,
  c.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  e.FULL_NAME,
  e.EMAIL_ADDRESS;

SELECT
  d.ACTIVITY_TITLE AS subject_title,
  c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME AS category_name,
  s.SESSION_TITLE AS session_title,
  s.SESSION_START_TIME AS session_start_time,
  s.SESSION_END_TIME AS session_end_time,
  sp.SPONSOR_NAME AS sponsor_name,
  COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, sp.SPONSOR_NAME) AS total_number_of_sessions
FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d
JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY c
  ON c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY
JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION s
  ON s.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY = d.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY
JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR sp
  ON sp.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY = d.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY;

SELECT
  d.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS department_name,
  sc.SUBJECT_CODE AS subject_code,
  sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC AS subject_code_description,
  cd.GRADUATE_LEVEL AS graduate_level,
  COUNT(DISTINCT sc.COURSE_NUMBER) AS total_courses
FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d
JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION cd
  ON cd.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE
JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc
  ON sc.COURSE_NUMBER = cd.COURSE
GROUP BY
  d.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  sc.SUBJECT_CODE,
  sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC,
  cd.GRADUATE_LEVEL
ORDER BY
  d.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  sc.SUBJECT_CODE,
  cd.GRADUATE_LEVEL;

SELECT
  ata.TERM_CODE AS term_code,
  ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS term_description,
  COALESCE(atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM, 'N') AS is_current_term,
  COUNT(DISTINCT ccc.SUBJECT_ID) AS total_cis_course_types
FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata
LEFT JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER atp
  ON atp.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE
LEFT JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc
  ON ccc.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE

SELECT

SELECT

    ON tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY

SELECT
    b.BUILDING_NAME AS building_name,
    b.BUILDING_NUMBER AS building_number,
    fb.BUILDING_HEIGHT AS building_height,
    b.BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS AS street_address,
    fba.CITY AS city,
    fba.STATE AS state,
    fo.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME AS hr_department_name,
    b.BLDG_ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE AS assignable_square_footage,
    SUM(CAST(fr.AREA AS DECIMAL(18,2))) AS total_square_footage,

    fba.CITY,

    b.BLDG_ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE
ORDER BY
    b.BLDG_ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE DESC,

WITH term_subject_counts AS (
  SELECT
    TERM_CODE,
    COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_ID) AS total_subject_types_per_term
  FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED
  GROUP BY TERM_CODE
),
instructor_course_counts AS (
  SELECT
    instructor,
    COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_ID) AS courses_ever_taught_by_instructor
  FROM (
    SELECT
      SUBJECT_ID,
      TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(FALL_INSTRUCTORS, ',', n.n), ',', -1)) AS instructor
    FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED
    JOIN (
      SELECT 1 AS n UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5
      UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 9 UNION ALL SELECT 10
      UNION ALL SELECT 11 UNION ALL SELECT 12 UNION ALL SELECT 13 UNION ALL SELECT 14 UNION ALL SELECT 15
      UNION ALL SELECT 16 UNION ALL SELECT 17 UNION ALL SELECT 18 UNION ALL SELECT 19 UNION ALL SELECT 20
    ) n
      ON n.n <= 1 + LENGTH(COALESCE(FALL_INSTRUCTORS, '')) - LENGTH(REPLACE(COALESCE(FALL_INSTRUCTORS, ''), ',', ''))
    WHERE COALESCE(FALL_INSTRUCTORS, '') <> ''
  ) x
  WHERE instructor <> ''
  GROUP BY instructor
),
term_instructors AS (
  SELECT
    c.TERM_CODE,
    c.SUBJECT_ID,
    c.SUBJECT_TITLE,
    c.PREREQUISITES,
    TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(c.FALL_INSTRUCTORS, ',', n.n), ',', -1)) AS instructor
  FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c
  JOIN (
    SELECT 1 AS n UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5
    UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 9 UNION ALL SELECT 10
    UNION ALL SELECT 11 UNION ALL SELECT 12 UNION ALL SELECT 13 UNION ALL SELECT 14 UNION ALL SELECT 15
    UNION ALL SELECT 16 UNION ALL SELECT 17 UNION ALL SELECT 18 UNION ALL SELECT 19 UNION ALL SELECT 20
  ) n
    ON n.n <= 1 + LENGTH(COALESCE(c.FALL_INSTRUCTORS, '')) - LENGTH(REPLACE(COALESCE(c.FALL_INSTRUCTORS, ''), ',', ''))
  WHERE c.TERM_CODE = '2023FA'
    AND COALESCE(c.FALL_INSTRUCTORS, '') <> ''
)
SELECT DISTINCT
  t.TERM_DESCRIPTION,
  ti.TERM_CODE,
  ti.SUBJECT_TITLE,
  ti.PREREQUISITES,
  tsc.total_subject_types_per_term,
  ti.instructor AS course_instructor,
  icc.courses_ever_taught_by_instructor
FROM term_instructors ti
JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t
  ON t.TERM_CODE = ti.TERM_CODE
JOIN term_subject_counts tsc
  ON tsc.TERM_CODE = ti.TERM_CODE
LEFT JOIN instructor_course_counts icc
  ON icc.instructor = ti.instructor
ORDER BY
  t.TERM_DESCRIPTION,
  ti.SUBJECT_TITLE,
  ti.instructor;

SELECT
  r.ROOM_FULL_NAME AS room_full_name,
  b.BUILDING_NAME AS building_name,
  f.FLOOR AS floor_number,
  o.ORGANIZATION_NAME AS organization_name,
  o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME AS department_name,
  CAST(r.AREA AS DECIMAL(18,4)) AS room_area,
  CAST(f.ASSIGNABLE_AREA AS DECIMAL(18,4)) AS floor_assignable_area,
  CAST(b.ASSIGNABLE_AREA AS DECIMAL(18,4)) AS building_assignable_area,
  ROUND(
    100 * CAST(r.AREA AS DECIMAL(18,6)) / NULLIF(CAST(f.ASSIGNABLE_AREA AS DECIMAL(18,6)), 0),
    2
  ) AS pct_room_over_floor_assignable_area,
  ROUND(
    100 * CAST(r.AREA AS DECIMAL(18,6)) / NULLIF(CAST(b.ASSIGNABLE_AREA AS DECIMAL(18,6)), 0),
    2
  ) AS pct_room_over_building_assignable_area
FROM FAC_ROOMS r
JOIN FAC_BUILDING b
  ON r.BUILDING_KEY = b.FAC_BUILDING_KEY
JOIN FAC_FLOOR f
  ON r.FLOOR_KEY = f.FLOOR_KEY
JOIN FAC_ORGANIZATION o
  ON r.ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.ORGANIZATION_KEY;

SELECT

  ) AS pct_room_over_floor_area,
  ROUND(
    100 * CAST(r.AREA AS DECIMAL(18,6)) / NULLIF(CAST(b.EXT_GROSS_AREA AS DECIMAL(18,6)), 0),
    4
  ) AS pct_room_over_building_area
FROM FAC_ROOMS r
JOIN FAC_BUILDING b

LEFT JOIN FAC_FLOOR f
  ON f.FLOOR_KEY = r.FLOOR_KEY

     OR RIGHT(t.TERM_CODE, 2) = 'FA'
),
instructor_counts AS (

    COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_ID) AS total_subject_types

  ic.total_subject_types
FROM fall_subjects fs
JOIN EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY ed

    MAX(b.BLDG_ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS TOTAL_ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE,

        CASE

        END
    ) AS BUILT_YEAR

    ON b.BUILDING_KEY = fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY
LEFT JOIN FAC_ROOMS fr
    ON fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY = fr.BUILDING_KEY

    ON fr.ORGANIZATION_KEY = fo.ORGANIZATION_KEY

SELECT
  c.SUBJECT_TITLE,
  c.SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION,
  c.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME,
  e.EMAIL_ADDRESS,
  b.BUILDING_NAME,
  r.ROOM_FULL_NAME,
  f.LEVEL_ID AS FLOOR_LEVEL,
  COALESCE(b.BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS, CONCAT_WS(' ',
    a.STREET_NUMBER,
    a.STREET_NUMBER_SUFFIX,
    a.PRE_DIRECTIONAL,
    a.STREET_NAME,
    a.STREET_SUFFIX,
    a.POST_DIRECTIONAL
  )) AS BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS,
  dc.total_course_types_per_department
FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c
JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t
  ON t.TERM_CODE = c.TERM_CODE
LEFT JOIN EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY e
  ON e.MIT_ID = c.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID
LEFT JOIN FAC_ROOMS r
  ON r.FAC_ROOM_KEY = c.MEET_PLACE
LEFT JOIN FAC_FLOOR f
  ON f.FLOOR_KEY = r.FLOOR_KEY
LEFT JOIN BUILDINGS b
  ON b.BUILDING_KEY = r.BUILDING_KEY
LEFT JOIN FAC_BUILDING_ADDRESS a
  ON a.BUILDING_KEY = r.BUILDING_KEY
 AND a.ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'STREET'
JOIN (
  SELECT
    DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_ID) AS total_course_types_per_department
  FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED
  GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_CODE
) dc
  ON dc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE
WHERE c.TERM_CODE LIKE '%SU%';

SELECT
  t.TERM_CODE,
  t.TERM_DESCRIPTION,
  c.HASS_ATTRIBUTE_DESC AS ATTRIBUTE_DESCRIPTION,
  d.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  d.SCHOOL_NAME,
  COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS NUM_SUBJECTS

  ON t.TERM_CODE = c.TERM_CODE
JOIN CIS_HASS_ATTRIBUTE h
  ON h.HASS_ATTRIBUTE = c.HASS_ATTRIBUTE
JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d
  ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE
WHERE h.CIS_ATTRIBUTE_GROUP = 'H'
GROUP BY
  t.TERM_CODE,
  t.TERM_DESCRIPTION,
  c.HASS_ATTRIBUTE_DESC,
  d.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  d.SCHOOL_NAME
ORDER BY
  t.TERM_CODE,
  c.HASS_ATTRIBUTE_DESC,
  d.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  d.SCHOOL_NAME;

SELECT
    fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY AS building_key,
    fb.BUILDING_NAME AS building_name,
    fb.BUILDING_HEIGHT AS building_height,
    b.BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS AS street_address,
    fba.CITY AS city,
    fba.STATE AS state,
    fba.POSTAL_CODE AS postal_code,
    fb.EXT_GROSS_AREA AS gross_square_footage,
    fb.ASSIGNABLE_AREA AS assignable_square_footage,
    flr.min_level_id AS smallest_floor_level,
    flr.max_level_id AS largest_floor_level,
    rm.total_room_area AS total_room_area
FROM FAC_BUILDING fb
LEFT JOIN BUILDINGS b
    ON b.BUILDING_KEY = fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY
LEFT JOIN FAC_BUILDING_ADDRESS fba
    ON fba.BUILDING_KEY = fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY
   AND fba.ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'STREET'
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        BUILDING_KEY,
        MIN(CAST(LEVEL_ID AS DECIMAL(10,2))) AS min_level_id,
        MAX(CAST(LEVEL_ID AS DECIMAL(10,2))) AS max_level_id
    FROM FAC_FLOOR
    GROUP BY BUILDING_KEY
) flr
    ON flr.BUILDING_KEY = fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        r.BUILDING_KEY,
        SUM(CAST(r.AREA AS DECIMAL(18,2))) AS total_room_area
    FROM FAC_ROOMS r
    GROUP BY r.BUILDING_KEY
) rm
    ON rm.BUILDING_KEY = fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY;

    MAX(CAST(NULLIF(lrc.CATALOG_YEAR, '0') AS UNSIGNED)) AS max_publication_year,
    COUNT(DISTINCT lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS) AS total_materials_status
FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrmd
JOIN LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR lci
    ON lrmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY
JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG lrc
    ON lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = lrc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY
JOIN LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS lms
    ON lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY

  MIN(CASE WHEN lrc.CATALOG_YEAR REGEXP '^[0-9]{4}$' THEN CAST(lrc.CATALOG_YEAR AS UNSIGNED) END) AS min_publication_year,
  MAX(CASE WHEN lrc.CATALOG_YEAR REGEXP '^[0-9]{4}$' THEN CAST(lrc.CATALOG_YEAR AS UNSIGNED) END) AS max_publication_year,
  SUM(DISTINCT lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students
FROM LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR lci
JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrmd
  ON lrmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY
JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG lrc
  ON lrc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY
JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso
  ON lso.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
GROUP BY
  lci.INSTRUCTOR_NAME;

SELECT
  lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_CODE AS library_material_status_code,
  lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS AS material_status,
  lso.TERM_CODE AS term_code,
  at.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS term_description,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(lso.SUBJECT_ID, ':', lso.COURSE_NUMBER)) AS total_number_of_courses,
  COUNT(DISTINCT lrc.CATALOG_SYSTEM_NUMBER) AS total_number_of_materials,
  COUNT(DISTINCT lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE) AS occurrences_in_departments,
  COUNT(DISTINCT lso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME) AS occurrences_in_school,
  COUNT(DISTINCT lci.INSTRUCTOR_NAME) AS total_number_of_instructors
FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrmd
JOIN LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS lms
  ON lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY
JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso
  ON lso.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
JOIN LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR lci
  ON lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY
JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG lrc
  ON lrc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY
LEFT JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL at
  ON at.TERM_CODE = lso.TERM_CODE
GROUP BY
  lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_CODE,
  lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS,
  lso.TERM_CODE,
  at.TERM_DESCRIPTION
ORDER BY
  lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_CODE,
  lso.TERM_CODE;

WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    b.BUILDING_KEY,
    b.BUILDING_NUMBER,
    b.BUILDING_NAME,
    b.BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS,
    sf.FLOOR,
    su.SPACE_UNIT,
    org.ORGANIZATION_NAME,
    usg.SPACE_USAGE
  FROM BUILDINGS b
  JOIN SPACE_DETAIL sd
    ON sd.BUILDING_KEY = b.BUILDING_KEY
  JOIN SPACE_FLOOR sf
    ON sf.FLOOR_KEY = sd.FLOOR_KEY
  JOIN SPACE_UNIT su
    ON su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = sd.SPACE_UNIT_KEY
  JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION org
    ON org.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = su.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY
  JOIN SPACE_USAGE usg
    ON usg.SPACE_USAGE_KEY = sd.SPACE_USAGE_KEY
  JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS fba
    ON fba.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.BUILDING_KEY
   AND fba.ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'STREET'
  WHERE b.BUILDING_NUMBER = '36'
),
counts AS (
  SELECT
    BUILDING_KEY,
    FLOOR,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ORGANIZATION_NAME) AS organizations_on_building_floor,
    COUNT(DISTINCT SPACE_UNIT) AS space_units_on_building_floor
  FROM base
  GROUP BY BUILDING_KEY, FLOOR
)
SELECT
  base.SPACE_UNIT,
  base.FLOOR,
  base.BUILDING_NAME,
  base.BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS,
  base.SPACE_USAGE,
  counts.organizations_on_building_floor,
  counts.space_units_on_building_floor
FROM base
JOIN counts
  ON counts.BUILDING_KEY = base.BUILDING_KEY
 AND counts.FLOOR = base.FLOOR
ORDER BY
  base.FLOOR,
  base.SPACE_UNIT,
  base.SPACE_USAGE;

SELECT
  ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME AS list_name,
  ml.IS_MOIRA_MAILING_LIST AS is_mailing_list,
  ml.IS_MOIRA_GROUP AS is_moira_group,
  ml.IS_NFS_GROUP AS is_nfs_group,
  mlo.OWNER AS owner,
  COUNT(DISTINCT mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER) AS people_count
FROM MOIRA_LIST ml
JOIN MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL mld
  ON ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
LEFT JOIN MOIRA_LIST_OWNER mlo
  ON mlo.MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY = mld.MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY
WHERE UPPER(ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME) LIKE 'A%'
GROUP BY
  ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
  ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
  ml.IS_MOIRA_MAILING_LIST,
  ml.IS_MOIRA_GROUP,
  ml.IS_NFS_GROUP,
  mlo.OWNER
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER) > 1000
ORDER BY people_count DESC, list_name, owner;

WITH member_counts AS (
  SELECT
    mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
    COUNT(*) AS member_count
  FROM MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL mld
  GROUP BY mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
),
extremes AS (
  SELECT
    MAX(member_count) AS max_cnt,
    MIN(member_count) AS min_cnt
  FROM member_counts
)
SELECT
  ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME AS list_name,
  mlo.OWNER AS owner,
  ml.IS_PUBLIC AS is_public,
  ml.IS_HIDDEN AS is_hidden,
  mc.member_count AS number_of_members
FROM member_counts mc
JOIN extremes e
  ON mc.member_count IN (e.max_cnt, e.min_cnt)
JOIN MOIRA_LIST ml
  ON ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = mc.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
JOIN MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL mld
  ON mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
JOIN MOIRA_LIST_OWNER mlo
  ON mlo.MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY = mld.MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY
WHERE ml.IS_MOIRA_MAILING_LIST = 'Y'
GROUP BY
  ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
  mlo.OWNER,
  ml.IS_PUBLIC,
  ml.IS_HIDDEN,
  mc.member_count
ORDER BY
  mc.member_count DESC,
  ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
  mlo.OWNER;

SELECT
    ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME AS list_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER) AS people_in_list,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
        WHEN ed.MIT_ID IS NOT NULL THEN mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID
        ELSE NULL
    END) AS faculty_in_list
FROM MOIRA_LIST ml
JOIN MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL mld
    ON mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
JOIN EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY ed
    ON ed.MIT_ID = mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID
JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso
    ON ccso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID = ed.MIT_ID
JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at
    ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE
WHERE UPPER(ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME) LIKE 'C%'
  AND at.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR > '2001'
  AND UPPER(at.TERM_CODE) LIKE '%SU%'
GROUP BY ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME
ORDER BY ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME;

SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT sp.MIT_ID) AS num_students,
  COUNT(DISTINCT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS num_departments,
  COUNT(DISTINCT sd.SCHOOL_CODE) AS num_schools
FROM MOIRA_LIST ml
JOIN MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL mld
  ON ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
JOIN SE_PERSON sp
  ON sp.MIT_ID = mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID
JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd
  ON msd.EMAIL_ADDRESS = mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER
JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd
  ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT
WHERE ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME LIKE '%duo%'
  AND sp.EMPLOYEE_TYPE = 'Student';

WITH faculty_courses AS (
  SELECT
    c.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID AS mit_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS course_count
  FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c
  WHERE c.TERM_CODE = '2023FA'
    AND c.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY c.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID
),
faculty_kerb AS (
  SELECT
    e.MIT_ID AS mit_id,
    e.KRB_NAME AS krb_name
  FROM EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY e
  WHERE e.MIT_ID IS NOT NULL
    AND e.KRB_NAME IS NOT NULL
),
list_member_counts AS (
  SELECT
    d.MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
    COUNT(DISTINCT d.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER) AS member_count
  FROM MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL d
  GROUP BY d.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
),
faculty_list AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    d.MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
    fk.mit_id
  FROM MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL d
  JOIN faculty_kerb fk
    ON fk.krb_name = d.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER
  JOIN faculty_courses fc
    ON fc.mit_id = fk.mit_id
)
SELECT
  ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME AS mailing_list_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT fl.mit_id) AS faculty_in_list,
  SUM(fc.course_count) AS courses_associated_with_those_faculty
FROM faculty_list fl
JOIN MOIRA_LIST ml
  ON ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = fl.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
JOIN list_member_counts lmc
  ON lmc.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = fl.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
JOIN faculty_courses fc
  ON fc.mit_id = fl.mit_id
WHERE lmc.member_count = 10
GROUP BY ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME
ORDER BY ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME;

WITH keeper_members AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
         mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID AS MIT_ID
  FROM MOIRA_LIST ml
  JOIN MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL mld
    ON mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
  WHERE ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME = 'keeper-zephyr'
    AND mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID IS NOT NULL
),
member_lists AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
         mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID AS MIT_ID,
         ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME
  FROM MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL mld
  JOIN MOIRA_LIST ml
    ON ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
  WHERE mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID IS NOT NULL
),
instructor_courses AS (
  SELECT
      lci.INSTRUCTOR_NAME,
      lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS,
      CASE
        WHEN lrc.CATALOG_YEAR REGEXP '^[0-9]{4}$' THEN CAST(lrc.CATALOG_YEAR AS UNSIGNED)
        ELSE NULL
      END AS pub_year
  FROM LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR lci
  JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrmd
    ON lrmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY
  JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG lrc
    ON lrc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY
  JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso
    ON lso.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
)
SELECT
    ml2.MOIRA_LIST_NAME AS mailing_list_name,
    lci.INSTRUCTOR_NAME AS instructor_name,
    MIN(ic.pub_year) AS earliest_publication_year,
    MAX(ic.pub_year) AS latest_publication_year,
    SUM(ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students
FROM keeper_members km
JOIN SE_PERSON sp
  ON sp.MIT_ID = km.MIT_ID
JOIN LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR lci
  ON lci.INSTRUCTOR_NAME = sp.FULL_NAME
JOIN member_lists ml2
  ON ml2.MIT_ID = km.MIT_ID
JOIN instructor_courses ic
  ON ic.INSTRUCTOR_NAME = lci.INSTRUCTOR_NAME
GROUP BY
    ml2.MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
    lci.INSTRUCTOR_NAME
ORDER BY
    lci.INSTRUCTOR_NAME,
    ml2.MOIRA_LIST_NAME;

SELECT
    ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME AS list_name,
    ml.MOIRA_LIST_DESCRIPTION AS list_description,
    mlo.OWNER AS owner,
    COUNT(DISTINCT mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER) AS people_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
        WHEN sp_mem.PAYROLL_RANK LIKE '%Tenured%' THEN sp_mem.MIT_ID
        ELSE NULL
    END) AS tenured_faculty_count
FROM MOIRA_LIST ml
JOIN MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL mld
    ON mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
JOIN MOIRA_LIST_OWNER mlo
    ON mlo.MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY = mld.MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY
JOIN SE_PERSON sp_sub
    ON sp_sub.MIT_ID = mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID
   AND sp_sub.FULL_NAME = 'Hopkins, Ayden'
WHERE UPPER(ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME) LIKE 'R%'
  AND ml.IS_MOIRA_MAILING_LIST = 'Y'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL mld2
      JOIN SE_PERSON sp2
        ON sp2.MIT_ID = mld2.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID
      WHERE mld2.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
        AND sp2.FULL_NAME = 'Hopkins, Ayden'
  )
LEFT JOIN SE_PERSON sp_mem
    ON sp_mem.MIT_ID = mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID
GROUP BY
    ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
    ml.MOIRA_LIST_DESCRIPTION,
    mlo.OWNER
ORDER BY
    ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
    mlo.OWNER;

SELECT
  ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME AS list_name,
  sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME AS department_name,
  COUNT(*) AS management_students,
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / totals.total_students, 2) AS management_student_percentage
FROM MOIRA_LIST ml
JOIN MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL mld
  ON mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
JOIN SE_PERSON sp
  ON sp.KRB_NAME = mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER
JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd
  ON msd.FULL_NAME = sp.FULL_NAME
JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad
  ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT
JOIN (
  SELECT
    ml2.MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
    COUNT(*) AS total_students
  FROM MOIRA_LIST ml2
  JOIN MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL mld2
    ON mld2.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = ml2.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
  JOIN SE_PERSON sp2
    ON sp2.KRB_NAME = mld2.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER
  JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd2
    ON msd2.FULL_NAME = sp2.FULL_NAME
  WHERE ml2.MOIRA_LIST_NAME = 'date-destiny'
  GROUP BY ml2.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
) totals
  ON totals.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
WHERE ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME = 'date-destiny'
  AND sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Management'
GROUP BY
  ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
  sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  totals.total_students;

WITH building_floor_counts AS (
  SELECT
    fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ff.LEVEL_ID) AS floor_cnt
  FROM FAC_BUILDING fb
  JOIN FAC_ROOMS fr
    ON fr.BUILDING_KEY = fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY
  JOIN FAC_FLOOR ff
    ON ff.FLOOR_KEY = fr.FLOOR_KEY
  GROUP BY fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY
),
top_building AS (
  SELECT FAC_BUILDING_KEY
  FROM building_floor_counts
  ORDER BY floor_cnt DESC, FAC_BUILDING_KEY
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT DISTINCT
  fb.BUILDING_NAME AS building_name,
  ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME AS mailing_list_name
FROM top_building tb
JOIN FAC_BUILDING fb
  ON fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY = tb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY
JOIN FAC_ROOMS fr
  ON fr.BUILDING_KEY = fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY
JOIN EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY ed
  ON ed.OFFICE_LOCATION = fr.FAC_ROOM_KEY
JOIN MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL mld
  ON mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER = ed.KRB_NAME
JOIN MOIRA_LIST ml
  ON ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
WHERE LOWER(ed.KRB_NAME) LIKE 'c%'
  AND LOWER(ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME) LIKE 'a%';

SELECT
    ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME AS list_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS total_subjects_managed_by_faculty_in_list,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ed.MIT_ID) AS number_of_such_faculty_in_list
FROM MOIRA_LIST ml
JOIN MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL mld
    ON mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
JOIN EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY ed
    ON ed.MIT_ID = mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID
JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c
    ON c.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID = ed.MIT_ID
WHERE ml.IS_MOIRA_MAILING_LIST = 'Y'
  AND ed.LAST_NAME LIKE 'Y%'
GROUP BY ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME
ORDER BY ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME;

SELECT
  msd.FULL_NAME AS student_name,
  sad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER AS department_phone_number,
  ml_size.list_size AS mailing_list_size
FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd
JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd
  ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE
JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad
  ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE
JOIN SE_PERSON sp
  ON msd.FULL_NAME = sp.FULL_NAME
JOIN MOIRA_LIST ml
  ON ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME = 'beacon-date-date'
JOIN MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL mld
  ON mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
 AND mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER = sp.KRB_NAME
JOIN (
  SELECT
    ml2.MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
    COUNT(*) AS list_size
  FROM MOIRA_LIST ml2
  JOIN MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL mld2
    ON mld2.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = ml2.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
  WHERE ml2.MOIRA_LIST_NAME = 'beacon-date-date'
  GROUP BY ml2.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
) AS ml_size
  ON ml_size.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
WHERE msd.LAST_NAME LIKE 'H%';

WITH eecs_counts AS (
  SELECT
    ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME AS list_name,
    COUNT(*) AS eecs_member_count
  FROM MOIRA_LIST ml
  JOIN MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL mld
    ON mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
  JOIN SE_PERSON sp
    ON sp.KRB_NAME = mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER
  WHERE ml.IS_MOIRA_MAILING_LIST = 'Y'
    AND ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME LIKE 'B%'
    AND sp.ORGANIZATION = 'Electrical Engineering and Computer Science'
  GROUP BY ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME
),
summary AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS mailing_list_count,
    MAX(eecs_member_count) AS max_eecs_member_count
  FROM eecs_counts
)
SELECT
  s.mailing_list_count,
  ec.list_name AS top_list_name,
  s.max_eecs_member_count AS top_list_eecs_member_count
FROM summary s
JOIN eecs_counts ec
  ON ec.eecs_member_count = s.max_eecs_member_count
ORDER BY ec.list_name
LIMIT 1;

WITH list_students AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
         sp.KRB_NAME,
         msd.DEPARTMENT
  FROM MOIRA_LIST ml
  JOIN MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL mld
    ON mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
  JOIN SE_PERSON sp
    ON sp.KRB_NAME = mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER
  JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd
    ON msd.FULL_NAME = sp.FULL_NAME
  WHERE ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME = 'kangaroo-inspire-yearn'
),
dept_counts AS (
  SELECT
    ls.DEPARTMENT,
    COUNT(*) AS student_count
  FROM list_students ls
  GROUP BY ls.DEPARTMENT
),
total_count AS (
  SELECT SUM(student_count) AS total_students
  FROM dept_counts
)
SELECT
  sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME AS department_name,
  dc.student_count AS num_students,
  ROUND(100.0 * dc.student_count / NULLIF(tc.total_students, 0), 2) AS pct_of_list
FROM dept_counts dc
JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad
  ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = dc.DEPARTMENT
CROSS JOIN total_count tc
ORDER BY dc.student_count DESC, department_name;

SELECT
  ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME AS mailing_list_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER) AS total_subscribers
FROM EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY ed
JOIN MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL mld
  ON ed.KRB_NAME = mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER
JOIN MOIRA_LIST ml
  ON ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
WHERE ml.IS_MOIRA_MAILING_LIST = 'Y'
  AND ed.OFFICE_LOCATION LIKE '24%'
GROUP BY ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME
ORDER BY total_subscribers DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
  ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME AS list_name,
  SUM(CASE WHEN sp.EMPLOYEE_TYPE = 'Support Staff' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS support_staff_subscribers,
  SUM(CASE WHEN sp.EMPLOYEE_TYPE = 'Faculty' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS faculty_subscribers,
  ml.IS_ACTIVE AS active_status
FROM MOIRA_LIST ml
JOIN MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL mld
  ON ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
JOIN SE_PERSON sp
  ON sp.MIT_ID = mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID
WHERE sp.EMPLOYEE_TYPE IN ('Support Staff', 'Faculty')
GROUP BY
  ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
  ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
  ml.IS_ACTIVE
HAVING
  SUM(CASE WHEN sp.EMPLOYEE_TYPE = 'Support Staff' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
  OR SUM(CASE WHEN sp.EMPLOYEE_TYPE = 'Faculty' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
ORDER BY
  ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME;

WITH dept_counts AS (
  SELECT
    d.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME AS department_name,
    d.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER AS phone_number,
    COUNT(*) AS student_count
  FROM MOIRA_LIST l
  JOIN MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL ld
    ON ld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = l.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
  JOIN SE_PERSON p
    ON p.KRB_NAME = ld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER
  JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY s
    ON s.FULL_NAME = p.FULL_NAME
  JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT d
    ON d.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT
  WHERE l.MOIRA_LIST_NAME = 'ocean-apple'
  GROUP BY
    d.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    d.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER
),
max_count AS (
  SELECT MAX(student_count) AS max_student_count
  FROM dept_counts
)
SELECT
  dc.department_name,
  dc.phone_number,
  dc.student_count
FROM dept_counts dc
JOIN max_count mc
  ON dc.student_count = mc.max_student_count;

SELECT
  o.OWNER AS owner,
  o.OWNER_TYPE AS owner_type,
  CASE WHEN l.IS_PUBLIC = 'Y' THEN 'Public Members' ELSE 'Hidden Members' END AS member_visibility,
  COUNT(d.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER) AS member_count
FROM MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL d
JOIN MOIRA_LIST l
  ON l.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = d.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
JOIN MOIRA_LIST_OWNER o
  ON o.MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY = d.MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY
JOIN MOIRA_LIST ml
  ON ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = d.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
WHERE ml.IS_MOIRA_MAILING_LIST = 'Y'
GROUP BY
  o.OWNER,
  o.OWNER_TYPE,
  CASE WHEN l.IS_PUBLIC = 'Y' THEN 'Public Members' ELSE 'Hidden Members' END

UNION ALL

SELECT
  o.OWNER AS owner,
  o.OWNER_TYPE AS owner_type,
  NULL AS member_visibility,
  COUNT(d.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER) AS member_count
FROM MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL d
JOIN MOIRA_LIST ml
  ON ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = d.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
JOIN MOIRA_LIST_OWNER o
  ON o.MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY = d.MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY
WHERE ml.IS_MOIRA_MAILING_LIST = 'Y'
GROUP BY
  o.OWNER,
  o.OWNER_TYPE;

WITH bio_courses AS (
  SELECT
    sos.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY,
    sos.COURSE_NUMBER,
    sos.SUBJECT_TITLE,
    sos.OFFER_DEPT_NAME,
    sos.CLUSTER_TYPE,
    sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS
  FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos
  WHERE UPPER(sos.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) LIKE '%BIO%'
),
course_level_map AS (
  SELECT
    scd.COURSE,
    MAX(scd.COURSE_LEVEL) AS COURSE_LEVEL
  FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd
  GROUP BY scd.COURSE
),
cluster_avg AS (
  SELECT
    bc.CLUSTER_TYPE,
    AVG(bc.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS AVG_ENROLLMENT_WITHIN_CLUSTER
  FROM bio_courses bc
  GROUP BY bc.CLUSTER_TYPE
),
tip_agg AS (
  SELECT
    td.SUBJECT_ID,
    COUNT(DISTINCT tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS UNIQUE_COURSE_MATERIALS,
    AVG(tm.NEW_SHELF_PRICE) AS AVG_NEW_SHELF_PRICE,
    AVG(tm.USED_SHELF_PRICE) AS AVG_USED_SHELF_PRICE,
    SUM(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS TOTAL_TIP_MATERIAL_RECORD_COUNT
  FROM TIP_DETAIL td
  JOIN TIP_MATERIAL tm
    ON tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
  GROUP BY td.SUBJECT_ID
),
library_agg AS (
  SELECT
    lrc.CATALOG_SYSTEM_NUMBER,
    COUNT(DISTINCT lrc.CATALOG_TITLE) AS UNIQUE_LIBRARY_TITLES,
    COUNT(DISTINCT lrc.CATALOG_ISBN) AS UNIQUE_LIBRARY_ISBNS
  FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG lrc
  GROUP BY lrc.CATALOG_SYSTEM_NUMBER
)
SELECT
  bc.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department_name,
  bc.SUBJECT_TITLE AS course_title,
  bc.CLUSTER_TYPE AS cluster_type,
  SUM(bc.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollments,
  ca.AVG_ENROLLMENT_WITHIN_CLUSTER AS avg_enrollment_within_cluster,
  clm.COURSE_LEVEL AS course_level,
  COUNT(DISTINCT tm.TITLE) AS unique_course_material_titles,
  AVG(tm.NEW_SHELF_PRICE) AS avg_new_shelf_price,
  AVG(tm.USED_SHELF_PRICE) AS avg_used_shelf_price,
  SUM(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_tip_material_record_count,
  COALESCE(SUM(la.UNIQUE_LIBRARY_TITLES), 0) AS unique_library_titles,
  COALESCE(SUM(la.UNIQUE_LIBRARY_ISBNS), 0) AS unique_library_isbns
FROM bio_courses bc
LEFT JOIN course_level_map clm
  ON clm.COURSE = bc.COURSE_NUMBER
LEFT JOIN cluster_avg ca
  ON ca.CLUSTER_TYPE = bc.CLUSTER_TYPE
LEFT JOIN TIP_DETAIL td
  ON td.SUBJECT_ID = bc.SUBJECT_ID
LEFT JOIN TIP_MATERIAL tm
  ON tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
LEFT JOIN library_agg la
  ON la.CATALOG_SYSTEM_NUMBER = tm.ISBN
GROUP BY
  bc.OFFER_DEPT_NAME,
  bc.SUBJECT_TITLE,
  bc.CLUSTER_TYPE,
  ca.AVG_ENROLLMENT_WITHIN_CLUSTER,
  clm.COURSE_LEVEL;

WITH RECURSIVE
base AS (
    SELECT
        c.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
        d.SCHOOL_NAME,
        c.SUBJECT_ID,
        c.SUBJECT_TITLE,
        scd.COURSE_LEVEL,
        c.TOTAL_UNITS,
        c.TERM_CODE,
        at.TERM_DESCRIPTION,
        c.FALL_INSTRUCTORS,
        c.SPRING_INSTRUCTORS,
        c.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM,
        c.IS_OFFERED_SPRING_TERM
    FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c
    JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at
        ON at.TERM_CODE = c.TERM_CODE
    JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d
        ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE
    LEFT JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd
        ON scd.COURSE = c.SUBJECT_CODE
       AND c.TERM_CODE BETWEEN scd.FROM_TERM AND scd.THRU_TERM
    WHERE c.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y'
      AND (c.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' OR c.IS_OFFERED_SPRING_TERM = 'Y')
),
fall_tokens AS (
    SELECT
        SUBJECT_ID,
        TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(FALL_INSTRUCTORS, ',', 1)) AS instructor,
        CASE
            WHEN FALL_INSTRUCTORS IS NULL OR TRIM(FALL_INSTRUCTORS) = '' THEN ''
            WHEN INSTR(FALL_INSTRUCTORS, ',') = 0 THEN ''
            ELSE LTRIM(SUBSTRING(FALL_INSTRUCTORS, INSTR(FALL_INSTRUCTORS, ',') + 1))
        END AS rest
    FROM base
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        SUBJECT_ID,
        TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(rest, ',', 1)) AS instructor,
        CASE
            WHEN rest IS NULL OR TRIM(rest) = '' THEN ''
            WHEN INSTR(rest, ',') = 0 THEN ''
            ELSE LTRIM(SUBSTRING(rest, INSTR(rest, ',') + 1))
        END AS rest
    FROM fall_tokens
    WHERE rest IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(rest) <> ''
),
spring_tokens AS (
    SELECT
        SUBJECT_ID,
        TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SPRING_INSTRUCTORS, ',', 1)) AS instructor,
        CASE
            WHEN SPRING_INSTRUCTORS IS NULL OR TRIM(SPRING_INSTRUCTORS) = '' THEN ''
            WHEN INSTR(SPRING_INSTRUCTORS, ',') = 0 THEN ''
            ELSE LTRIM(SUBSTRING(SPRING_INSTRUCTORS, INSTR(SPRING_INSTRUCTORS, ',') + 1))
        END AS rest
    FROM base
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        SUBJECT_ID,
        TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(rest, ',', 1)) AS instructor,
        CASE
            WHEN rest IS NULL OR TRIM(rest) = '' THEN ''
            WHEN INSTR(rest, ',') = 0 THEN ''
            ELSE LTRIM(SUBSTRING(rest, INSTR(rest, ',') + 1))
        END AS rest
    FROM spring_tokens
    WHERE rest IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(rest) <> ''
),
fall_counts AS (
    SELECT SUBJECT_ID, COUNT(DISTINCT instructor) AS fall_instructor_count
    FROM fall_tokens
    WHERE instructor IS NOT NULL AND instructor <> ''
    GROUP BY SUBJECT_ID
),
spring_counts AS (
    SELECT SUBJECT_ID, COUNT(DISTINCT instructor) AS spring_instructor_count
    FROM spring_tokens
    WHERE instructor IS NOT NULL AND instructor <> ''
    GROUP BY SUBJECT_ID
)
SELECT
    b.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    b.SCHOOL_NAME,
    b.SUBJECT_ID,
    b.SUBJECT_TITLE,
    b.COURSE_LEVEL,
    b.TOTAL_UNITS,
    CASE
        WHEN b.IS_OFFERED_SPRING_TERM = 'Y' THEN 'Spring'
        ELSE 'Fall'
    END AS term_offered,
    b.TERM_DESCRIPTION,
    COALESCE(fc.fall_instructor_count, 0) AS distinct_fall_instructors,
    COALESCE(sc.spring_instructor_count, 0) AS distinct_spring_instructors
FROM base b
LEFT JOIN fall_counts fc
    ON fc.SUBJECT_ID = b.SUBJECT_ID
LEFT JOIN spring_counts sc
    ON sc.SUBJECT_ID = b.SUBJECT_ID
WHERE b.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' OR b.IS_OFFERED_SPRING_TERM = 'Y'
ORDER BY
    b.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    b.SUBJECT_ID,
    term_offered,
    b.TERM_CODE;

SELECT

SELECT

WITH base AS (

  FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm
  JOIN LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS lms
    ON lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = lrm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY
  JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG lrc
    ON lrc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = lrm.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY
  JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso
    ON lso.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = lrm.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
  JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc
    ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER
  WHERE CAST(lrc.CATALOG_YEAR AS UNSIGNED) >= 2000
),
agg AS (
  SELECT
    material_status,
    department_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT catalog_key) AS num_catalog_items,
    SUM(DISTINCT CONCAT(subject_offered_key, ':', num_enrolled_students)) AS _dummy
  FROM base
  GROUP BY material_status, department_name
),
dept_status AS (
  SELECT
    material_status,
    department_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT catalog_key) AS num_catalog_items,
    SUM(num_enrolled_students) AS total_enrolled_students
  FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      material_status,
      department_name,
      catalog_key,
      subject_offered_key,
      num_enrolled_students
    FROM base
  ) d
  GROUP BY material_status, department_name
),
status_subtotals AS (
  SELECT
    material_status,
    'Subtotal' AS department_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT catalog_key) AS num_catalog_items,
    SUM(num_enrolled_students) AS total_enrolled_students
  FROM (

      material_status,
      catalog_key,
      subject_offered_key,
      num_enrolled_students
    FROM base
  ) s
  GROUP BY material_status
),
grand_total AS (
  SELECT
    'Grand Total' AS material_status,
    'Grand Total' AS department_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT catalog_key) AS num_catalog_items,
    SUM(num_enrolled_students) AS total_enrolled_students
  FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      catalog_key,
      subject_offered_key,
      num_enrolled_students
    FROM base
  ) g
)
SELECT
  material_status,
  department_name,
  num_catalog_items,
  total_enrolled_students
FROM dept_status
UNION ALL
SELECT
  material_status,
  department_name,
  num_catalog_items,
  total_enrolled_students
FROM status_subtotals
UNION ALL
SELECT
  material_status,
  department_name,
  num_catalog_items,
  total_enrolled_students

ORDER BY
  CASE WHEN material_status = 'Grand Total' THEN 2 ELSE 0 END,

  END,

WITH dept_course AS (

      lci.DEPARTMENT,

  FROM LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR lci
  JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrmd
    ON lrmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY
),
dept_catalog AS (
  SELECT
      lci.DEPARTMENT,
      COUNT(DISTINCT lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS catalog_items
  FROM LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR lci
  JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrmd
    ON lrmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY
  JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG lrc
    ON lrc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY
  GROUP BY lci.DEPARTMENT
),
dept_enrollment AS (
  SELECT
      lci.DEPARTMENT,
      AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment_per_course
  FROM (
      SELECT DISTINCT
          lci.DEPARTMENT,
          lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY,
          lci.COURSE_NAME,
          lrmd.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
      FROM LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR lci
      JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrmd
        ON lrmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY
  ) x
  JOIN LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR lci
    ON lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = x.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY
  JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso

  GROUP BY lci.DEPARTMENT
),
dept_summary AS (

  GROUP BY dc.DEPARTMENT
)
SELECT

    den.avg_enrollment_per_course
FROM dept_summary ds
LEFT JOIN dept_catalog dcat
  ON dcat.DEPARTMENT = ds.DEPARTMENT

  ON den.DEPARTMENT = ds.DEPARTMENT

UNION ALL

status_agg AS (

grand_total AS (

    NULL AS BUILDING_ROOM,
    NULL AS ORGANIZATION_NAME,
    COUNT(*) AS room_count,
    SUM(rb.AREA) AS area,
    (SUM(rb.AREA) / NULLIF(ba.building_area, 0)) * 100 AS pct
  FROM room_base rb
  JOIN building_area ba
    ON ba.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = rb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
  GROUP BY
    rb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, rb.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, rb.OWNERSHIP_TYPE, rb.FLOOR, ba.building_area
),
building_sub AS (
  SELECT
    ba.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY,
    b.BUILDING_NAME_LONG,
    b.OWNERSHIP_TYPE,
    NULL AS FLOOR,
    NULL AS BUILDING_ROOM,
    NULL AS ORGANIZATION_NAME,
    COUNT(*) AS room_count,
    SUM(rb.AREA) AS area,
    (SUM(rb.AREA) / NULLIF(ab.all_buildings_area, 0)) * 100 AS pct
  FROM building_area ba
  JOIN FCLT_BUILDING b
    ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = ba.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
  JOIN room_base rb
    ON rb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = ba.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
  CROSS JOIN all_buildings ab
  GROUP BY
    ba.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, b.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, b.OWNERSHIP_TYPE, ab.all_buildings_area
),
grand_total AS (
  SELECT
    NULL AS FCLT_BUILDING_KEY,
    NULL AS BUILDING_NAME_LONG,
    NULL AS OWNERSHIP_TYPE,
    NULL AS FLOOR,
    NULL AS BUILDING_ROOM,
    NULL AS ORGANIZATION_NAME,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM room_base) AS room_count,
    (SELECT SUM(AREA) FROM room_base) AS area,
    100.00 AS pct
)
SELECT
  outq.row_type,
  outq.BUILDING_NAME_LONG AS building_name,
  outq.FLOOR AS floor_number,
  outq.BUILDING_ROOM AS room_number,
  outq.OWNERSHIP_TYPE AS ownership_type,
  outq.ORGANIZATION_NAME AS organization_name,
  FORMAT(ROUND(outq.room_count), 0) AS number_of_rooms,
  FORMAT(ROUND(outq.area), 0) AS area,
  ROUND(outq.pct, 2) AS pct_area
FROM (
  SELECT
    1 AS sort_group,
    1 AS sort_row,
    'DETAIL' AS row_type,
    FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, BUILDING_NAME_LONG, OWNERSHIP_TYPE, FLOOR, BUILDING_ROOM, ORGANIZATION_NAME,
    room_count, area, pct
  FROM detail

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    1 AS sort_group,
    2 AS sort_row,
    'FLOOR SUBTOTAL' AS row_type,
    FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, BUILDING_NAME_LONG, OWNERSHIP_TYPE, FLOOR, BUILDING_ROOM, ORGANIZATION_NAME,
    room_count, area, pct
  FROM floor_sub

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    2 AS sort_group,
    3 AS sort_row,
    'BUILDING SUBTOTAL' AS row_type,
    FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, BUILDING_NAME_LONG, OWNERSHIP_TYPE, FLOOR, BUILDING_ROOM, ORGANIZATION_NAME,
    room_count, area, pct
  FROM building_sub

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    3 AS sort_group,
    4 AS sort_row,
    'GRAND TOTAL' AS row_type,
    FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, BUILDING_NAME_LONG, OWNERSHIP_TYPE, FLOOR, BUILDING_ROOM, ORGANIZATION_NAME,
    room_count, area, pct
  FROM grand_total
) AS outq
ORDER BY
  outq.sort_group,
  outq.BUILDING_NAME_LONG,
  CASE WHEN outq.FLOOR IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
  CAST(outq.FLOOR AS UNSIGNED),
  outq.sort_row,
  outq.BUILDING_ROOM;

SELECT

  MIN(td.START_DATE) AS start_term_date,

  COUNT(DISTINCT atp.TERM_PARAMETER) AS num_distinct_department_level_term_parameters
FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at
LEFT JOIN TIME_DAY td
  ON at.TERM_START_DATE = td.CALENDAR_DATE
LEFT JOIN TIME_MONTH tm
  ON td.FISCAL_PERIOD = tm.FISCAL_PERIOD
LEFT JOIN TIME_QUARTER tq
  ON tq.FISCAL_YEAR = tm.FISCAL_YEAR
LEFT JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER atp

WITH
addr AS (

),
floors AS (

    FCLT_BUILDING_KEY,

  FROM FCLT_FLOOR
  GROUP BY FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
),
rooms AS (
  SELECT
    FCLT_BUILDING_KEY,
    COUNT(DISTINCT FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS total_rooms,
    COUNT(DISTINCT FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS total_organizations
  FROM FCLT_ROOMS
  GROUP BY FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
),
base AS (
  SELECT
    b.CAMPUS_SECTOR,
    b.BUILDING_NAME_LONG,
    a.CITY,
    a.STATE,
    COALESCE(f.total_floors, 0) AS total_floors,
    COALESCE(b.ASSIGNABLE_AREA, 0) AS total_assignable_area,
    COALESCE(r.total_rooms, 0) AS total_rooms,
    COALESCE(r.total_organizations, 0) AS total_organizations,
    b.OWNERSHIP_TYPE
  FROM FCLT_BUILDING b
  LEFT JOIN addr  a ON a.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
  LEFT JOIN floors f ON f.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
  LEFT JOIN rooms  r ON r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
),
detail AS (
  SELECT
    CAMPUS_SECTOR,
    BUILDING_NAME_LONG,
    CITY,
    STATE,
    total_floors,
    total_assignable_area,
    total_rooms,
    total_organizations,
    OWNERSHIP_TYPE,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY CAMPUS_SECTOR
      ORDER BY total_assignable_area DESC, BUILDING_NAME_LONG
    ) AS sector_rank,
    0 AS sort_level
  FROM base
),
sector_subtotals AS (
  SELECT
    CAMPUS_SECTOR,
    'SUBTOTAL' AS BUILDING_NAME_LONG,
    NULL AS CITY,
    NULL AS STATE,
    SUM(total_floors) AS total_floors,
    SUM(total_assignable_area) AS total_assignable_area,
    NULL AS total_rooms,
    NULL AS total_organizations,
    NULL AS OWNERSHIP_TYPE,
    NULL AS sector_rank,
    1 AS sort_level
  FROM base
  GROUP BY CAMPUS_SECTOR
),
grand_total AS (
  SELECT
    'GRAND TOTAL' AS CAMPUS_SECTOR,
    'GRAND TOTAL' AS BUILDING_NAME_LONG,
    NULL AS CITY,
    NULL AS STATE,
    SUM(total_floors) AS total_floors,
    SUM(total_assignable_area) AS total_assignable_area,
    NULL AS total_rooms,
    NULL AS total_organizations,
    NULL AS OWNERSHIP_TYPE,
    NULL AS sector_rank,
    2 AS sort_level
  FROM base
)
SELECT
  CAMPUS_SECTOR,
  BUILDING_NAME_LONG,
  CITY,
  STATE,
  total_floors,
  total_assignable_area,
  total_rooms,
  total_organizations,
  OWNERSHIP_TYPE,
  sector_rank
FROM (
  SELECT * FROM detail
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM sector_subtotals
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM grand_total
) x
ORDER BY
  CASE WHEN sort_level = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
  CAMPUS_SECTOR,
  sort_level,
  total_assignable_area DESC,
  BUILDING_NAME_LONG;

WITH
tip AS (
  SELECT
    tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS dept_name,
    tm.TITLE AS tip_title,
    tm.AUTHOR AS tip_author,
    tm.ISBN AS tip_isbn
  FROM TIP_DETAIL td
  JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso
    ON tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
  JOIN TIP_MATERIAL tm
    ON tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
),
lib_avail AS (
  SELECT
    lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS dept_name,
    lrm.TERM_CODE AS library_term_code,
    lrc.CATALOG_ISBN AS catalog_isbn,
    lrm.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY AS catalog_key
  FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm
  JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso
    ON lso.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = lrm.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
  JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG lrc
    ON lrc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = lrm.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY
),
dept_isbn_term AS (
  SELECT
    dept_name,
    catalog_isbn,
    MIN(library_term_code) AS library_term_code
  FROM lib_avail
  GROUP BY dept_name, catalog_isbn
),
instructors_per_dept_book AS (
  SELECT
    lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS dept_name,
    lrm.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY AS catalog_key,
    COUNT(DISTINCT lrm.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY) AS total_instructors_per_library_book
  FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm
  JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso
    ON lso.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = lrm.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
  GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lrm.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY
),
dept_total_available AS (
  SELECT
    dept_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT catalog_key) AS total_materials_available_in_library_for_dept
  FROM lib_avail
  GROUP BY dept_name
),
all_total_available AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT catalog_key) AS total_available_materials_all_departments
  FROM lib_avail
)
SELECT
  t.dept_name AS department_name,
  t.tip_title AS tip_material_title,
  t.tip_author AS author,
  t.tip_isbn AS isbn,
  dit.library_term_code AS library_term_code,
  CASE
    WHEN dit.catalog_isbn IS NOT NULL THEN 'Available in Library'
    ELSE 'Not Available in Library'
  END AS availability_in_library_reserves,
  COALESCE(ip.total_instructors_per_library_book, 0) AS total_instructors_per_library_book_for_department,
  COALESCE(dta.total_materials_available_in_library_for_dept, 0) AS total_materials_available_in_library_for_department,
  ata.total_available_materials_all_departments AS total_available_materials_across_all_departments
FROM tip t
LEFT JOIN dept_isbn_term dit
  ON dit.dept_name = t.dept_name
 AND dit.catalog_isbn = t.tip_isbn
LEFT JOIN lib_avail la
  ON la.dept_name = t.dept_name
 AND la.catalog_isbn = t.tip_isbn
LEFT JOIN instructors_per_dept_book ip
  ON ip.dept_name = t.dept_name
 AND ip.catalog_key = la.catalog_key
LEFT JOIN dept_total_available dta
  ON dta.dept_name = t.dept_name
CROSS JOIN all_total_available ata
ORDER BY
  t.dept_name, t.tip_title, t.tip_isbn;

WITH
tip_counts AS (
  SELECT
    tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS dept_name,
    tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS AS material_status,
    COUNT(DISTINCT td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS tip_materials
  FROM TIP_DETAIL td
  JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso
    ON tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
  JOIN TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS tms
    ON tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY
  GROUP BY
    tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME,
    tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS
),
lib_counts AS (
  SELECT
    lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS dept_name,
    lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS AS material_status,
    COUNT(DISTINCT lrd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS library_materials
  FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrd
  JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso
    ON lso.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = lrd.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
  JOIN LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS lms
    ON lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = lrd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY
  GROUP BY
    lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME,
    lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS
),
combined AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(t.dept_name, l.dept_name) AS dept_name,
    COALESCE(t.material_status, l.material_status) AS material_status,
    COALESCE(t.tip_materials, 0) AS tip_materials,
    COALESCE(l.library_materials, 0) AS library_materials,
    COALESCE(t.tip_materials, 0) + COALESCE(l.library_materials, 0) AS total_materials
  FROM tip_counts t
  LEFT JOIN lib_counts l
    ON l.dept_name = t.dept_name
   AND l.material_status = t.material_status
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    l.dept_name,
    l.material_status,
    0 AS tip_materials,
    l.library_materials,
    l.library_materials AS total_materials
  FROM lib_counts l
  LEFT JOIN tip_counts t
    ON t.dept_name = l.dept_name
   AND t.material_status = l.material_status
  WHERE t.dept_name IS NULL
)
SELECT
  CASE WHEN GROUPING(dept_name) = 1 THEN 'Grand Total' ELSE dept_name END AS department_name,
  CASE
    WHEN GROUPING(dept_name) = 0 AND GROUPING(material_status) = 1 THEN 'Subtotal'
    WHEN GROUPING(dept_name) = 1 AND GROUPING(material_status) = 1 THEN 'Grand Total'
    ELSE material_status
  END AS material_status,
  SUM(tip_materials) AS tip_material_count,
  SUM(library_materials) AS library_material_count,
  SUM(total_materials) AS total_material_count
FROM combined
GROUP BY dept_name, material_status WITH ROLLUP
HAVING NOT (GROUPING(dept_name) = 1 AND GROUPING(material_status) = 0)
ORDER BY
  (GROUPING(dept_name) = 1) ASC,
  dept_name ASC,
  (GROUPING(material_status) = 1) ASC,
  material_status ASC;

SELECT

WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY,
    fb.BUILDING_NUMBER,
    fb.PARENT_BUILDING_NUMBER,
    fb.OWNERSHIP_TYPE,
    fb.DATE_BUILT,
    fb.DATE_OCCUPIED
  FROM FAC_BUILDING fb
  WHERE fb.OWNERSHIP_TYPE = 'OWNED'
    AND (fb.PARENT_BUILDING_NUMBER IS NULL OR fb.PARENT_BUILDING_NUMBER = '')
),
rows_pre AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN DATE_BUILT IS NULL OR DATE_BUILT = '' THEN 'UNKNOWN'
      WHEN STR_TO_DATE(DATE_BUILT, '%m/%d/%Y') IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(YEAR(STR_TO_DATE(DATE_BUILT, '%m/%d/%Y')) AS CHAR)
      WHEN STR_TO_DATE(DATE_BUILT, '%d-%b-%y') IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(YEAR(STR_TO_DATE(DATE_BUILT, '%d-%b-%y')) AS CHAR)
      ELSE 'UNKNOWN'
    END AS built_year,
    BUILDING_NUMBER AS building_number,
    CASE
      WHEN DATE_OCCUPIED IS NULL OR DATE_OCCUPIED = '' THEN 'UNKNOWN'
      WHEN STR_TO_DATE(DATE_OCCUPIED, '%m/%d/%Y') IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(YEAR(STR_TO_DATE(DATE_OCCUPIED, '%m/%d/%Y')) AS CHAR)
      WHEN STR_TO_DATE(DATE_OCCUPIED, '%d-%b-%y') IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(YEAR(STR_TO_DATE(DATE_OCCUPIED, '%d-%b-%y')) AS CHAR)
      ELSE 'UNKNOWN'
    END AS occupied_year
  FROM base
),
rows_ord AS (
  SELECT
    built_year,
    building_number,
    occupied_year,
    LAG(built_year) OVER (
      ORDER BY (built_year = 'UNKNOWN') ASC, built_year ASC, building_number ASC
    ) AS prev_built_year
  FROM rows_pre
),
final_rows AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN prev_built_year IS NULL OR built_year <> prev_built_year THEN built_year
      ELSE NULL
    END AS construction_start_year,
    building_number,
    occupied_year AS initial_occupancy_year,
    0 AS sort_key
  FROM rows_ord
),
total_row AS (
  SELECT
    NULL AS construction_start_year,
    CONCAT(COUNT(*), ' Buildings') AS building_number,
    NULL AS initial_occupancy_year,
    1 AS sort_key
  FROM base
)
SELECT construction_start_year, building_number, initial_occupancy_year
FROM (
  SELECT * FROM final_rows
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM total_row
) x
ORDER BY sort_key, (construction_start_year IS NULL) ASC, construction_start_year ASC, building_number ASC;

WITH
b_latest AS (
  SELECT bh.*
  FROM FCLT_BUILDING_HIST bh
  JOIN (
    SELECT FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, MAX(FISCAL_PERIOD) AS max_period
    FROM FCLT_BUILDING_HIST
    WHERE SITE = 'MIT'
    GROUP BY FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
  ) mx
    ON mx.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = bh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
   AND mx.max_period = bh.FISCAL_PERIOD
  WHERE bh.SITE = 'MIT'
),
b_agg AS (
  SELECT
    OWNERSHIP_TYPE,
    BUILDING_USE,
    COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(PARENT_BUILDING_NUMBER, BUILDING_NUMBER)) AS num_buildings,
    ROUND(SUM(EXT_GROSS_AREA)) AS gross_sqft
  FROM b_latest
  GROUP BY OWNERSHIP_TYPE, BUILDING_USE
),
r_agg AS (
  SELECT
    bl.OWNERSHIP_TYPE,
    bl.BUILDING_USE,
    COUNT(DISTINCT r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS num_rooms,
    COUNT(DISTINCT r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS num_organizations
  FROM b_latest bl
  LEFT JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r
    ON r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = bl.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
  GROUP BY bl.OWNERSHIP_TYPE, bl.BUILDING_USE
),
detail AS (
  SELECT
    b.OWNERSHIP_TYPE,
    b.BUILDING_USE,
    b.num_buildings,
    b.gross_sqft,
    COALESCE(r.num_rooms, 0) AS num_rooms,
    COALESCE(r.num_organizations, 0) AS num_organizations
  FROM b_agg b
  LEFT JOIN r_agg r
    ON r.OWNERSHIP_TYPE = b.OWNERSHIP_TYPE
   AND r.BUILDING_USE = b.BUILDING_USE
),
rollup_rows AS (
  SELECT
    OWNERSHIP_TYPE,
    BUILDING_USE,
    SUM(num_buildings) AS num_buildings,
    SUM(gross_sqft) AS gross_sqft,
    SUM(num_rooms) AS num_rooms,
    SUM(num_organizations) AS num_organizations,
    GROUPING(OWNERSHIP_TYPE) AS g_own,
    GROUPING(BUILDING_USE) AS g_use
  FROM detail
  GROUP BY OWNERSHIP_TYPE, BUILDING_USE WITH ROLLUP
),
final_rows AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN g_own = 1 AND g_use = 1 THEN NULL
      WHEN g_use = 1 THEN NULL
      ELSE OWNERSHIP_TYPE
    END AS ownership_type,
    CASE
      WHEN g_own = 1 AND g_use = 1 THEN NULL
      WHEN g_use = 1 THEN NULL
      ELSE BUILDING_USE
    END AS usage_type,
    num_buildings,
    gross_sqft,
    num_rooms,
    num_organizations,
    g_own,
    g_use
  FROM rollup_rows
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN g_own = 0 AND g_use = 0
      THEN CASE
             WHEN ownership_type = LAG(ownership_type) OVER (ORDER BY ownership_type, usage_type) THEN NULL
             ELSE ownership_type
           END
    ELSE NULL
  END AS ownership_type,
  CASE
    WHEN g_own = 0 AND g_use = 0 THEN usage_type
    ELSE NULL
  END AS usage_type,
  num_buildings AS number_of_buildings,
  FORMAT(gross_sqft, 0) AS gross_square_footage,
  num_rooms AS number_of_rooms,
  num_organizations AS number_of_associated_organizations
FROM final_rows
ORDER BY
  CASE WHEN g_own = 1 AND g_use = 1 THEN 2 WHEN g_use = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
  ownership_type,
  usage_type;

WITH base_buildings AS (
  SELECT
    b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY,
    CASE
      WHEN b.BUILDING_TYPE = 'RESIDENT' THEN 'RESIDENTIAL'
      ELSE b.BUILDING_USE
    END AS use_type,
    b.EXT_GROSS_AREA
  FROM FCLT_BUILDING b
  WHERE b.PARENT_BUILDING_NUMBER IS NULL
     OR b.PARENT_BUILDING_NUMBER = b.BUILDING_NUMBER
),
orgs_by_use AS (
  SELECT
    bb.use_type,
    COUNT(DISTINCT r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS org_cnt
  FROM base_buildings bb
  LEFT JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r
    ON r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = bb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
  GROUP BY bb.use_type
),
buildings_by_use AS (
  SELECT
    bb.use_type,
    COUNT(DISTINCT bb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY) AS bldg_cnt,
    SUM(bb.EXT_GROSS_AREA) AS gross_sqft
  FROM base_buildings bb
  GROUP BY bb.use_type
),
final_by_use AS (
  SELECT
    b.use_type,
    b.bldg_cnt,
    b.gross_sqft,
    COALESCE(o.org_cnt, 0) AS org_cnt
  FROM buildings_by_use b
  LEFT JOIN orgs_by_use o
    ON o.use_type = b.use_type
)
SELECT
  use_type AS building_use,
  FORMAT(ROUND(bldg_cnt), 0) AS distinct_buildings,
  FORMAT(ROUND(gross_sqft), 0) AS total_gross_sqft,
  FORMAT(ROUND(org_cnt), 0) AS unique_organizations
FROM final_by_use

UNION ALL

SELECT
  'TOTAL' AS building_use,
  FORMAT(ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT bb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY)), 0) AS distinct_buildings,
  FORMAT(ROUND(SUM(bb.EXT_GROSS_AREA)), 0) AS total_gross_sqft,
  FORMAT(ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY)), 0) AS unique_organizations
FROM base_buildings bb
LEFT JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r
  ON r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = bb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY;

SELECT
  o.ORGANIZATION_ID AS organization_id,
  o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER AS organization_number,
  o.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL AS organization_level,
  CONCAT(REPEAT(' ', GREATEST(CAST(o.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL AS UNSIGNED) - 1, 0)), o.ORGANIZATION_NAME) AS formatted_organization_name,
  CASE WHEN o.ASSIGNABLE = '1' THEN 'ASSIGNABLE' ELSE 'NON-ASSIGNABLE' END AS assignable_status,
  FORMAT(ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(r.AREA), 0)), 0) AS total_area,
  FORMAT(ROUND(COUNT(r.ROOM)), 0) AS number_of_rooms,
  FORMAT(ROUND(COALESCE(AVG(r.AREA), 0)), 0) AS avg_room_area
FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION o
LEFT JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r
  ON r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY
WHERE o.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'Cambridge-MIT Institute'
GROUP BY
  o.ORGANIZATION_ID,
  o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER,
  o.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL,
  o.ORGANIZATION_NAME,
  o.ASSIGNABLE
ORDER BY
  CAST(o.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL AS UNSIGNED),
  o.ORGANIZATION_SORT,
  o.ORGANIZATION_NAME;

WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    CASE WHEN mu.ASSIGNABLE = '1' THEN 'ASSIGNABLE' ELSE 'NON-ASSIGNABLE' END AS assignable_status,
    mu.DESCRIPTION AS major_use_description,
    r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY,
    r.AREA
  FROM FCLT_ROOMS r
  JOIN FCLT_MAJOR_USE mu
    ON r.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY = mu.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY
  WHERE mu.MAJOR_USE NOT LIKE 'ZUSE.%'
    AND mu.DESCRIPTION NOT LIKE 'ZUSE.%'
),
agg AS (
  SELECT
    assignable_status,
    major_use_description,
    COUNT(*) AS total_rooms,
    SUM(AREA) AS total_area,
    AVG(AREA) AS avg_area
  FROM base
  GROUP BY assignable_status, major_use_description
),
rollup_rows AS (
  SELECT
    assignable_status,
    major_use_description,
    total_rooms,
    total_area,
    avg_area,
    CASE
      WHEN assignable_status IS NULL AND major_use_description IS NULL THEN 2
      WHEN major_use_description IS NULL THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS lvl
  FROM (
    SELECT
      assignable_status,
      major_use_description,
      COUNT(*) AS total_rooms,
      SUM(AREA) AS total_area,
      AVG(AREA) AS avg_area
    FROM base
    GROUP BY assignable_status, major_use_description WITH ROLLUP
  ) x
),
ordered AS (
  SELECT
    assignable_status,
    major_use_description,
    total_rooms,
    total_area,
    avg_area,
    lvl,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      ORDER BY
        CASE assignable_status WHEN 'ASSIGNABLE' THEN 0 WHEN 'NON-ASSIGNABLE' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END,
        major_use_description,
        lvl
    ) AS rn
  FROM rollup_rows
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN lvl > 0 THEN NULL
    WHEN rn = 1 THEN assignable_status
    WHEN assignable_status = LAG(assignable_status) OVER (
      ORDER BY
        CASE assignable_status WHEN 'ASSIGNABLE' THEN 0 WHEN 'NON-ASSIGNABLE' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END,
        major_use_description,
        lvl
    ) THEN NULL
    ELSE assignable_status
  END AS assignable_status,
  CASE
    WHEN lvl > 0 THEN NULL
    WHEN rn = 1 THEN major_use_description
    WHEN major_use_description = LAG(major_use_description) OVER (
      ORDER BY
        CASE assignable_status WHEN 'ASSIGNABLE' THEN 0 WHEN 'NON-ASSIGNABLE' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END,
        major_use_description,
        lvl
    ) THEN NULL
    ELSE major_use_description
  END AS major_use_description,
  total_rooms,
  total_area,
  avg_area
FROM ordered
ORDER BY
  CASE assignable_status WHEN 'ASSIGNABLE' THEN 0 WHEN 'NON-ASSIGNABLE' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END,
  major_use_description,
  lvl;

WITH dept_floor AS (
  SELECT
    fr.FLOOR_KEY,
    fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    COUNT(fr.FAC_ROOM_KEY) AS ROOM_COUNT,
    SUM(CAST(fr.AREA AS DECIMAL(18,2))) AS TOTAL_AREA
  FROM BUILDINGS b
  JOIN FAC_ROOMS fr
    ON b.BUILDING_KEY = fr.BUILDING_KEY
  JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo
    ON fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = fr.ORGANIZATION_KEY
  WHERE b.BUILDING_NAME LIKE '%Stata%'
  GROUP BY fr.FLOOR_KEY, fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME
),
rollup_rows AS (
  SELECT
    FLOOR_KEY,
    DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    ROOM_COUNT,
    TOTAL_AREA,
    TOTAL_AREA / NULLIF(ROOM_COUNT, 0) AS AVG_AREA,
    0 AS IS_FLOOR_SUBTOTAL,
    0 AS IS_GRAND_TOTAL
  FROM dept_floor

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    FLOOR_KEY,
    NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    SUM(ROOM_COUNT) AS ROOM_COUNT,
    SUM(TOTAL_AREA) AS TOTAL_AREA,
    SUM(TOTAL_AREA) / NULLIF(SUM(ROOM_COUNT), 0) AS AVG_AREA,
    1 AS IS_FLOOR_SUBTOTAL,
    0 AS IS_GRAND_TOTAL
  FROM dept_floor
  GROUP BY FLOOR_KEY

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    NULL AS FLOOR_KEY,
    NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    SUM(ROOM_COUNT) AS ROOM_COUNT,
    SUM(TOTAL_AREA) AS TOTAL_AREA,
    SUM(TOTAL_AREA) / NULLIF(SUM(ROOM_COUNT), 0) AS AVG_AREA,
    0 AS IS_FLOOR_SUBTOTAL,
    1 AS IS_GRAND_TOTAL
  FROM dept_floor
),
numbered AS (
  SELECT
    r.*,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY r.FLOOR_KEY
      ORDER BY (r.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NULL), r.DEPARTMENT_NAME
    ) AS RN_IN_FLOOR
  FROM rollup_rows r
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN IS_GRAND_TOTAL = 1 OR IS_FLOOR_SUBTOTAL = 1 THEN NULL
    WHEN RN_IN_FLOOR = 1 THEN FLOOR_KEY
    ELSE NULL
  END AS FLOOR_KEY,
  CASE
    WHEN IS_GRAND_TOTAL = 1 OR IS_FLOOR_SUBTOTAL = 1 THEN NULL
    ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME
  END AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  FORMAT(ROUND(ROOM_COUNT, 0), 0) AS NUMBER_OF_ROOMS,
  FORMAT(ROUND(TOTAL_AREA, 0), 0) AS TOTAL_AREA,
  FORMAT(ROUND(AVG_AREA, 0), 0) AS AVG_AREA
FROM numbered
ORDER BY
  (FLOOR_KEY IS NULL) ASC,
  FLOOR_KEY ASC,
  IS_GRAND_TOTAL ASC,
  IS_FLOOR_SUBTOTAL ASC,
  (DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NULL) ASC,
  DEPARTMENT_NAME ASC;

WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    r.BUILDING_KEY,
    r.FLOOR_KEY,
    COUNT(r.FAC_ROOM_KEY) AS room_cnt,
    SUM(CAST(r.AREA AS DECIMAL(18,2))) AS total_area,
    b.BUILDING_NAME_LONG AS building_name,
    b.ACCESS_LEVEL_NAME AS access_level,
    a.POSTAL_CODE AS zip_code,
    a.CITY AS city
  FROM FAC_ROOMS r
  JOIN FAC_ORGANIZATION o
    ON o.ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.ORGANIZATION_KEY
  JOIN FAC_BUILDING b
    ON b.FAC_BUILDING_KEY = r.BUILDING_KEY
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
      BUILDING_KEY,
      MAX(CASE WHEN ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'STREET' THEN POSTAL_CODE END) AS POSTAL_CODE,
      MAX(CASE WHEN ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'STREET' THEN CITY END) AS CITY
    FROM FAC_BUILDING_ADDRESS
    GROUP BY BUILDING_KEY
  ) a
    ON a.BUILDING_KEY = r.BUILDING_KEY
  WHERE o.ORGANIZATION_NAME = 'DEPARTMENT OF FACILITIES'
  GROUP BY
    r.BUILDING_KEY, r.FLOOR_KEY,
    b.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, b.ACCESS_LEVEL_NAME,
    a.POSTAL_CODE, a.CITY
),
building_totals AS (
  SELECT
    BUILDING_KEY,
    COUNT(DISTINCT FLOOR_KEY) AS floors_in_building,
    SUM(room_cnt) AS room_cnt,
    SUM(total_area) AS total_area
  FROM base
  GROUP BY BUILDING_KEY
),
grand_total AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT BUILDING_KEY) AS buildings,
    COUNT(DISTINCT FLOOR_KEY) AS floors,
    SUM(room_cnt) AS room_cnt,
    SUM(total_area) AS total_area
  FROM base
)
SELECT
  t.BUILDING_KEY,
  t.FLOOR_KEY,
  t.rooms_formatted AS number_of_rooms,
  t.total_area_formatted AS total_area,
  t.avg_area_per_floor_formatted AS avg_area_per_floor,
  t.building_name,
  t.access_level,
  t.zip_code,
  t.city,
  t.sort_building,
  t.sort_floor,
  t.sort_level
FROM (
  SELECT
    b.BUILDING_KEY,
    b.FLOOR_KEY,
    FORMAT(ROUND(b.room_cnt, 0), 0) AS rooms_formatted,
    FORMAT(ROUND(b.total_area, 0), 0) AS total_area_formatted,
    FORMAT(
      ROUND(
        b.total_area / NULLIF(bt.floors_in_building, 0),
        0
      ),
      0
    ) AS avg_area_per_floor_formatted,
    b.building_name,
    b.access_level,
    b.zip_code,
    b.city,
    b.BUILDING_KEY AS sort_building,
    b.FLOOR_KEY AS sort_floor,
    0 AS sort_level
  FROM base b
  JOIN building_totals bt
    ON bt.BUILDING_KEY = b.BUILDING_KEY

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    bt.BUILDING_KEY,
    'SUBTOTAL' AS FLOOR_KEY,
    FORMAT(ROUND(bt.room_cnt, 0), 0) AS rooms_formatted,
    FORMAT(ROUND(bt.total_area, 0), 0) AS total_area_formatted,
    FORMAT(ROUND(bt.total_area / NULLIF(bt.floors_in_building, 0), 0), 0) AS avg_area_per_floor_formatted,
    NULL AS building_name,
    NULL AS access_level,
    NULL AS zip_code,
    NULL AS city,
    bt.BUILDING_KEY AS sort_building,
    'ZZZ_SUBTOTAL' AS sort_floor,
    1 AS sort_level
  FROM building_totals bt

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    'GRAND TOTAL' AS BUILDING_KEY,
    NULL AS FLOOR_KEY,
    FORMAT(ROUND(gt.room_cnt, 0), 0) AS rooms_formatted,
    FORMAT(ROUND(gt.total_area, 0), 0) AS total_area_formatted,
    FORMAT(ROUND(gt.total_area / NULLIF(gt.floors, 0), 0), 0) AS avg_area_per_floor_formatted,
    NULL AS building_name,
    NULL AS access_level,
    NULL AS zip_code,
    NULL AS city,
    'ZZZ_GRAND_TOTAL' AS sort_building,
    'ZZZ_GRAND_TOTAL' AS sort_floor,
    2 AS sort_level
  FROM grand_total gt
) t
ORDER BY
  t.sort_building,
  t.sort_level,
  t.sort_floor;

WITH current_term AS (
  SELECT TERM_CODE
  FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER
  WHERE IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y'
),
course_rows AS (
  SELECT
    lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department,
    lso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME AS school,
    lso.COURSE_NUMBER AS course_number,
    lso.SUBJECT_TITLE AS subject_title,
    lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS enrolled_students,
    lso.TERM_CODE AS term_code,
    COUNT(DISTINCT lrc.CATALOG_ISBN) AS distinct_catalog_isbns
  FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso
  JOIN current_term ct
    ON ct.TERM_CODE = lso.TERM_CODE
  LEFT JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrmd
    ON lrmd.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = lso.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
  LEFT JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG lrc
    ON lrc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY
  GROUP BY
    lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME,
    lso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME,

    lso.SUBJECT_TITLE,

    lso.TERM_CODE
),
summary_row AS (
  SELECT
    'TOTAL:' AS department,
    NULL AS school,
    NULL AS course_number,
    NULL AS subject_title,
    (SELECT SUM(enrolled_students) FROM course_rows) AS enrolled_students,
    NULL AS term_code,
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT lrc.CATALOG_ISBN)
     FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso
     JOIN current_term ct
       ON ct.TERM_CODE = lso.TERM_CODE
     LEFT JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrmd
       ON lrmd.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = lso.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
     LEFT JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG lrc
       ON lrc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY

)
SELECT
  department,
  school,
  course_number,
  subject_title,
  enrolled_students,
