  distinct_catalog_isbns
FROM course_rows
UNION ALL
SELECT
  department,
  school,
  course_number,
  subject_title,
  enrolled_students,
  term_code,
  distinct_catalog_isbns
FROM summary_row;

WITH list_subscribers AS (
  SELECT
    mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
    COUNT(DISTINCT mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID) AS subscriber_cnt
  FROM MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL mld
  JOIN EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY ed
    ON ed.MIT_ID = mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID
  WHERE ed.DEPARTMENT_NAME LIKE 'Computer Science%'
  GROUP BY mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
),
list_owners AS (
  SELECT
    mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
    mlo.OWNER_TYPE,
    COUNT(DISTINCT mlo.OWNER) AS owner_cnt
  FROM MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL mld
  JOIN MOIRA_LIST_OWNER mlo
    ON mlo.MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY = mld.MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY
  GROUP BY mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY, mlo.OWNER_TYPE
),
base AS (
  SELECT
    lo.OWNER_TYPE,
    ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
    lo.owner_cnt,
    ls.subscriber_cnt
  FROM list_subscribers ls
  JOIN MOIRA_LIST ml
    ON ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = ls.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
  JOIN list_owners lo
    ON lo.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = ls.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
),
detail_rows AS (
  SELECT
    b.OWNER_TYPE AS type_field,
    b.MOIRA_LIST_NAME AS list_name,
    b.owner_cnt AS num_owners,
    b.subscriber_cnt AS num_subscribers,
    0 AS sort_level
  FROM base b
),
subtotal_rows AS (
  SELECT
    'SUBTOTAL' AS type_field,
    NULL AS list_name,
    SUM(b.owner_cnt) AS num_owners,
    SUM(b.subscriber_cnt) AS num_subscribers,
    1 AS sort_level,
    b.OWNER_TYPE AS owner_type_for_sort
  FROM base b
  GROUP BY b.OWNER_TYPE
),
total_row AS (
  SELECT
    'TOTAL' AS type_field,
    NULL AS list_name,
    SUM(b.owner_cnt) AS num_owners,
    SUM(b.subscriber_cnt) AS num_subscribers,
    2 AS sort_level,
    NULL AS owner_type_for_sort
  FROM base b
),
unioned AS (
  SELECT
    dr.type_field,
    dr.list_name,
    dr.num_owners,
    dr.num_subscribers,
    dr.sort_level,
    dr.type_field AS owner_type_for_sort
  FROM detail_rows dr
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    sr.type_field,
    sr.list_name,
    sr.num_owners,
    sr.num_subscribers,
    sr.sort_level,
    sr.owner_type_for_sort
  FROM subtotal_rows sr
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    tr.type_field,
    tr.list_name,
    tr.num_owners,
    tr.num_subscribers,
    tr.sort_level,
    tr.owner_type_for_sort
  FROM total_row tr
),
ordered AS (
  SELECT
    u.*,
    CASE
      WHEN u.sort_level = 0 THEN
        CASE
          WHEN LAG(u.owner_type_for_sort) OVER (ORDER BY u.owner_type_for_sort, u.sort_level, u.list_name) = u.owner_type_for_sort
          THEN NULL
          ELSE u.owner_type_for_sort
        END
      ELSE u.type_field
    END AS display_type
  FROM unioned u
)
SELECT
  o.display_type AS ownership_type,
  o.list_name,
  o.num_owners,
  o.num_subscribers
FROM ordered o
ORDER BY
  CASE WHEN o.owner_type_for_sort IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
  o.owner_type_for_sort,
  o.sort_level,
  o.list_name;

WITH
category_base AS (
  SELECT
    c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY,
    c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME,
    d.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY,
    d.MAX_ENROLLMENT,
    d.TERM_CODE,
    s.SPONSOR_NAME,
    ss.SESSION_START_TIME
  FROM IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY c
  JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d
    ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY
  LEFT JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR s
    ON s.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY = d.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY
  LEFT JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION ss
    ON ss.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY = d.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY
),
category_agg AS (
  SELECT
    IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY,
    IAP_CATEGORY_NAME,
    COUNT(DISTINCT IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY) AS unique_sessions,
    SUM(COALESCE(MAX_ENROLLMENT, 0)) AS total_attendees,
    CONCAT(MIN(TERM_CODE), '-', MAX(TERM_CODE)) AS active_period
  FROM category_base
  GROUP BY IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, IAP_CATEGORY_NAME
),
sponsor_mode AS (
  SELECT
    IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY,
    SPONSOR_NAME,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY
      ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, SPONSOR_NAME
    ) AS rn
  FROM category_base
  WHERE SPONSOR_NAME IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, SPONSOR_NAME
),
start_time_mode AS (
  SELECT
    IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY,
    SESSION_START_TIME,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY
      ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, SESSION_START_TIME
    ) AS rn
  FROM category_base
  WHERE SESSION_START_TIME IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, SESSION_START_TIME
)
SELECT
  ca.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME AS name,
  ca.unique_sessions AS number_of_unique_sessions,
  ca.total_attendees AS total_number_of_attendees,
  ca.active_period AS active_period,
  sm.SPONSOR_NAME AS most_common_sponsor_name,
  stm.SESSION_START_TIME AS most_common_session_start_time
FROM category_agg ca
LEFT JOIN sponsor_mode sm
  ON sm.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = ca.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY
 AND sm.rn = 1
LEFT JOIN start_time_mode stm
  ON stm.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = ca.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY
 AND stm.rn = 1

UNION ALL

SELECT
  'TOTAL' AS name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT d.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY) AS number_of_unique_sessions,
  SUM(COALESCE(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, 0)) AS total_number_of_attendees,
  NULL AS active_period,
  NULL AS most_common_sponsor_name,
  NULL AS most_common_session_start_time
FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d;

WITH
latest_bldg AS (
  SELECT h.*
  FROM FCLT_BUILDING_HIST h
  JOIN (
    SELECT FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, MAX(FISCAL_PERIOD) AS max_fiscal_period
    FROM FCLT_BUILDING_HIST
    GROUP BY FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
  ) m
    ON m.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = h.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
   AND m.max_fiscal_period = h.FISCAL_PERIOD
),
bldg_dim AS (
  SELECT
    lb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY AS BUILDING_KEY,
    CASE
      WHEN UPPER(lb.BUILDING_TYPE) = 'RESIDENT' THEN 'RESIDENTIAL'
      ELSE UPPER(lb.BUILDING_TYPE)
    END AS BUILDING_TYPE_NAME,
    lb.PARENT_BUILDING_NUMBER,
    lb.EXT_GROSS_AREA
  FROM latest_bldg lb
),
emp_by_bldg AS (
  SELECT
    fr.BUILDING_KEY,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ed.MIT_ID) AS EMP_CNT
  FROM FAC_ROOMS fr
  JOIN EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY ed
    ON ed.OFFICE_LOCATION = fr.FAC_ROOM_KEY
  GROUP BY fr.BUILDING_KEY
),
addr_by_bldg AS (
  SELECT
    fba.BUILDING_KEY,
    COUNT(DISTINCT b.BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS) AS STREET_ADDR_CNT,
    COUNT(DISTINCT fba.CITY) AS CITY_CNT,
    COUNT(DISTINCT fba.STATE) AS STATE_CNT,
    COUNT(DISTINCT fba.POSTAL_CODE) AS POSTAL_CODE_CNT
  FROM FAC_BUILDING_ADDRESS fba
  JOIN BUILDINGS b
    ON b.BUILDING_KEY = fba.BUILDING_KEY
  WHERE fba.ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'STREET'
  GROUP BY fba.BUILDING_KEY
),
by_type AS (
  SELECT
    d.BUILDING_TYPE_NAME AS BUILDING_TYPE,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
      WHEN d.PARENT_BUILDING_NUMBER IS NULL OR d.PARENT_BUILDING_NUMBER = '' THEN d.BUILDING_KEY
    END) AS NON_SUBDIVISION_BUILDINGS,
    SUM(COALESCE(e.EMP_CNT, 0)) AS EMPLOYEES,
    SUM(COALESCE(a.STREET_ADDR_CNT, 0)) AS UNIQUE_BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS,
    SUM(COALESCE(a.CITY_CNT, 0)) AS UNIQUE_CITY,
    SUM(COALESCE(a.STATE_CNT, 0)) AS UNIQUE_STATE,
    SUM(COALESCE(a.POSTAL_CODE_CNT, 0)) AS UNIQUE_POSTAL_CODE,
    SUM(COALESCE(d.EXT_GROSS_AREA, 0)) AS TOTAL_GROSS_SQFT
  FROM bldg_dim d
  LEFT JOIN emp_by_bldg e
    ON e.BUILDING_KEY = d.BUILDING_KEY
  LEFT JOIN addr_by_bldg a
    ON a.BUILDING_KEY = d.BUILDING_KEY
  GROUP BY d.BUILDING_TYPE_NAME
)
SELECT
  BUILDING_TYPE,
  NON_SUBDIVISION_BUILDINGS,
  EMPLOYEES,
  UNIQUE_BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS,
  UNIQUE_CITY,
  UNIQUE_STATE,
  UNIQUE_POSTAL_CODE,
  CASE WHEN EMPLOYEES = 0 THEN NULL ELSE TOTAL_GROSS_SQFT / EMPLOYEES END AS AVG_GROSS_SQFT_PER_EMPLOYEE
FROM by_type

UNION ALL

SELECT
  'TOTAL' AS BUILDING_TYPE,
  SUM(NON_SUBDIVISION_BUILDINGS) AS NON_SUBDIVISION_BUILDINGS,
  SUM(EMPLOYEES) AS EMPLOYEES,
  SUM(UNIQUE_BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS) AS UNIQUE_BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS,
  SUM(UNIQUE_CITY) AS UNIQUE_CITY,
  SUM(UNIQUE_STATE) AS UNIQUE_STATE,
  SUM(UNIQUE_POSTAL_CODE) AS UNIQUE_POSTAL_CODE,
  CASE WHEN SUM(EMPLOYEES) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE SUM(TOTAL_GROSS_SQFT) / SUM(EMPLOYEES) END AS AVG_GROSS_SQFT_PER_EMPLOYEE
FROM by_type;

WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    z.ACCESS_LEVEL AS access_level,
    su2.SPACE_USAGE AS usage_type,
    fo.DLC_NAME AS space_name,
    sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE AS room_sqft
  FROM SPACE_DETAIL sd
  JOIN ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD z
    ON z.BUILDING_ROOM = sd.BUILDING_ROOM
   AND z.BUILDING_COMPONENT = sd.BUILDING_COMPONENT
  JOIN SPACE_UNIT su
    ON su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = z.SPACE_UNIT_CODE
  JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo
    ON fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = su.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY
  JOIN SPACE_USAGE su2
    ON su2.SPACE_USAGE = z.SPACE_USAGE
  WHERE sd.BUILDING_KEY = '16'
    AND UPPER(su2.SPACE_USAGE) NOT LIKE '%STORAGE%'
),
agg AS (
  SELECT
    access_level,
    usage_type,
    space_name,
    COUNT(*) AS num_spaces,
    SUM(room_sqft) AS total_area,
    AVG(room_sqft) AS avg_area
  FROM base
  GROUP BY access_level, usage_type, space_name
),
roll AS (
  SELECT
    access_level,
    usage_type,
    space_name,
    SUM(num_spaces) AS num_spaces,
    SUM(total_area) AS total_area,
    SUM(total_area) / NULLIF(SUM(num_spaces),0) AS avg_area,
    GROUPING(access_level) AS g_access,
    GROUPING(usage_type) AS g_usage,
    GROUPING(space_name) AS g_space
  FROM agg
  GROUP BY access_level, usage_type, space_name WITH ROLLUP
),
final_rows AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN g_access = 1 THEN 'Grand Total'
      WHEN g_usage = 1 AND g_space = 1 THEN CONCAT('Access Level ', access_level, ' Total')
      WHEN g_space = 1 THEN CONCAT(usage_type, ' Total')
      ELSE space_name
    END AS row_label,
    access_level,
    usage_type,
    space_name,
    num_spaces,
    total_area,
    avg_area,
    g_access, g_usage, g_space
  FROM roll
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN g_access = 1 THEN NULL
    WHEN access_level = LAG(access_level) OVER (
           ORDER BY
             (g_access=1) ASC,
             access_level,
             (g_usage=1 AND g_space=1) DESC,
             usage_type,
             (g_space=1) DESC,
             space_name
         )
    THEN NULL
    ELSE access_level
  END AS access_level,
  CASE
    WHEN g_access = 1 THEN NULL
    WHEN g_usage = 1 AND g_space = 1 THEN NULL
    ELSE usage_type
  END AS usage_type,
  row_label AS space_name,
  FORMAT(ROUND(num_spaces,0),0) AS number_of_spaces,
  FORMAT(ROUND(total_area,0),0) AS total_area,
  FORMAT(ROUND(avg_area,0),0) AS average_area
FROM final_rows
ORDER BY
  (g_access=1) ASC,
  access_level,
  (g_usage=1 AND g_space=1) DESC,
  usage_type,
  (g_space=1) DESC,
  space_name;

SELECT

  fo.ORGANIZATION_ID AS organization_id,
  fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME AS organization_name,
  fo.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER AS organization_number,
  fo.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL AS organization_level,
  CASE
    WHEN fo.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = '1' THEN CONCAT(fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME)
    WHEN fo.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = '2' THEN CONCAT('  ', fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME)
    WHEN fo.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = '3' THEN CONCAT('    ', fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME)
    WHEN fo.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = '4' THEN CONCAT('      ', fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME)
    WHEN fo.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = '5' THEN CONCAT('        ', fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME)
    WHEN fo.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = '6' THEN CONCAT('          ', fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME)
    WHEN fo.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = '7' THEN CONCAT('            ', fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME)
    ELSE fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME
  END AS formatted_name,
  CASE
    WHEN fr.EMERITUS_STATUS IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(fr.EMERITUS_STATUS) <> '' THEN 'Emeritus'

  END AS emeritus_flag,
  COUNT(DISTINCT fr.MIT_ID) AS employer_count

  ON hou.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY
LEFT JOIN HR_FACULTY_ROSTER fr

WHERE fo.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('139', '250')

  fo.ORGANIZATION_SORT,
  fo.ORGANIZATION_ID,
  fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME,
  fo.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER,
  fo.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL,
  formatted_name,
  emeritus_flag

  AND fo.ORGANIZATION_ID IS NULL
  AND fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME IS NULL
  AND fo.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER IS NULL
  AND fo.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL IS NULL
  AND formatted_name IS NULL
  AND emeritus_flag IS NULL
)
ORDER BY

SELECT

    PARTITION BY c.ACADEMIC_YEAR
    ORDER BY t.TERM_START_DATE

FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c
JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t

LEFT JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r

WHERE t.TERM_START_DATE IS NOT NULL

course_with_dates AS (

dedup AS (

ORDER BY

WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    CASE WHEN at.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' THEN 'CURRENT' ELSE 'NON-CURRENT' END AS current_status,
    ss.CLUSTER_TYPE AS cluster_type,
    DATEDIFF(at.TERM_END_DATE, at.TERM_START_DATE) AS duration_days,
    ss.TOTAL_UNITS AS total_units
  FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss
  JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL at
    ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE
  WHERE ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME IN ('Biology', 'Chemistry')
),
agg AS (
  SELECT
    current_status,
    cluster_type,
    MAX(duration_days) AS max_duration_days,
    MAX(total_units) AS max_units,
    AVG(duration_days) AS avg_duration_days,
    AVG(total_units) AS avg_units,
    1 AS sort_group,
    current_status AS sort_status,
    cluster_type AS sort_cluster
  FROM base
  GROUP BY current_status, cluster_type

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    current_status,
    'SUBTOTAL' AS cluster_type,
    MAX(duration_days) AS max_duration_days,
    MAX(total_units) AS max_units,
    AVG(duration_days) AS avg_duration_days,
    AVG(total_units) AS avg_units,
    2 AS sort_group,
    current_status AS sort_status,
    'ZZZ' AS sort_cluster
  FROM base
  GROUP BY current_status

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    'TOTAL' AS current_status,
    'TOTAL' AS cluster_type,
    MAX(duration_days) AS max_duration_days,
    MAX(total_units) AS max_units,
    AVG(duration_days) AS avg_duration_days,
    AVG(total_units) AS avg_units,
    3 AS sort_group,
    'ZZZ' AS sort_status,
    'ZZZ' AS sort_cluster
  FROM base
),
final AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN current_status = LAG(current_status) OVER (ORDER BY sort_status, sort_group, sort_cluster)
      THEN NULL
      ELSE current_status
    END AS current_status,
    cluster_type,
    max_duration_days,
    max_units,
    avg_duration_days,
    avg_units,
    sort_status,
    sort_group,
    sort_cluster
  FROM agg
)
SELECT
  current_status,
  cluster_type,
  max_duration_days,
  max_units,
  avg_duration_days,
  avg_units
FROM final
ORDER BY sort_status, sort_group, sort_cluster;

WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    CASE WHEN at.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' THEN 'CURRENT' ELSE 'NON-CURRENT' END AS current_status,
    so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department_name,
    DATEDIFF(at.TERM_END_DATE, at.TERM_START_DATE) AS duration_days,
    ss.TOTAL_UNITS AS total_units
  FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss
  JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL at
    ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE
  JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED so
    ON so.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID
  WHERE so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Biology', 'Chemistry')
),
agg AS (
  SELECT
    current_status,
    department_name,
    MAX(duration_days) AS max_duration_days,
    MAX(total_units) AS max_units,
    AVG(duration_days) AS avg_duration_days,
    AVG(total_units) AS avg_units
  FROM base
  GROUP BY current_status, department_name

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    'SUBTOTAL' AS current_status,
    current_status AS department_name,
    MAX(duration_days) AS max_duration_days,
    MAX(total_units) AS max_units,
    AVG(duration_days) AS avg_duration_days,
    AVG(total_units) AS avg_units
  FROM base
  GROUP BY current_status

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    'TOTAL' AS current_status,
    NULL AS department_name,
    MAX(duration_days) AS max_duration_days,
    MAX(total_units) AS max_units,
    AVG(duration_days) AS avg_duration_days,
    AVG(total_units) AS avg_units
  FROM base
),
ordered AS (
  SELECT
    current_status,
    department_name,
    max_duration_days,
    max_units,
    avg_duration_days,
    avg_units,
    CASE current_status
      WHEN 'CURRENT' THEN 1
      WHEN 'NON-CURRENT' THEN 2
      WHEN 'SUBTOTAL' THEN 3
      WHEN 'TOTAL' THEN 4
      ELSE 5
    END AS status_sort,
    CASE
      WHEN current_status IN ('CURRENT','NON-CURRENT') THEN department_name
      WHEN current_status = 'SUBTOTAL' THEN department_name
      ELSE 'ZZZ'
    END AS dept_sort
  FROM agg
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN current_status IN ('CURRENT','NON-CURRENT')
      THEN CASE
             WHEN LAG(current_status) OVER (ORDER BY status_sort, dept_sort) = current_status
               THEN NULL
             ELSE current_status
           END
    ELSE current_status
  END AS current_status,
  department_name,
  max_duration_days,
  max_units,
  avg_duration_days,
  avg_units
FROM ordered
ORDER BY status_sort, dept_sort;

WITH course_rows AS (
  SELECT
    tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS dept_name,
    tso.MASTER_COURSE_NUMBER AS master_course_code,
    tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
  FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso
),
course_subjects AS (
  SELECT
    dept_name,
    master_course_code,
    COUNT(DISTINCT TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS subject_cnt
  FROM course_rows
  GROUP BY dept_name, master_course_code
),
course_materials AS (
  SELECT
    tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS dept_name,
    tso.MASTER_COURSE_NUMBER AS master_course_code,
    SUM(COALESCE(tm.NEW_SHELF_PRICE, 0)) AS total_new_shelf_price,
    COUNT(DISTINCT tm.ISBN) AS unique_materials
  FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso
  LEFT JOIN TIP_DETAIL td
    ON td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
  LEFT JOIN TIP_MATERIAL tm
    ON tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
  GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.MASTER_COURSE_NUMBER
),
base AS (
  SELECT
    cs.dept_name,
    cs.master_course_code,
    cs.subject_cnt,
    COALESCE(cm.total_new_shelf_price, 0) AS total_new_shelf_price,
    COALESCE(cm.unique_materials, 0) AS unique_materials
  FROM course_subjects cs
  LEFT JOIN course_materials cm
    ON cm.dept_name = cs.dept_name
   AND cm.master_course_code = cs.master_course_code
),
detail AS (
  SELECT
    dept_name,
    master_course_code,
    subject_cnt,
    total_new_shelf_price,
    unique_materials,
    0 AS sort_level
  FROM base
),
dept_subtotals AS (
  SELECT
    dept_name,
    NULL AS master_course_code,
    SUM(subject_cnt) AS subject_cnt,
    SUM(total_new_shelf_price) AS total_new_shelf_price,
    SUM(unique_materials) AS unique_materials,
    1 AS sort_level
  FROM base
  GROUP BY dept_name
),
grand_total AS (
  SELECT
    NULL AS dept_name,
    NULL AS master_course_code,
    SUM(subject_cnt) AS subject_cnt,
    SUM(total_new_shelf_price) AS total_new_shelf_price,
    SUM(unique_materials) AS unique_materials,
    2 AS sort_level
  FROM base
),
all_rows AS (
  SELECT * FROM detail
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM dept_subtotals
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM grand_total
),
ordered AS (
  SELECT
    dept_name,
    master_course_code,
    subject_cnt,
    total_new_shelf_price,
    unique_materials,
    sort_level,
    CASE
      WHEN sort_level = 2 THEN 'ZZZZZZZZZZ'
      ELSE dept_name
    END AS dept_sort,
    CASE
      WHEN sort_level = 0 THEN master_course_code
      WHEN sort_level = 1 THEN '~~~~SUBTOTAL~~~~'
      ELSE '~~~~GRANDTOTAL~~~~'
    END AS course_sort
  FROM all_rows
),
final AS (
  SELECT
    dept_name,
    master_course_code,
    subject_cnt,
    total_new_shelf_price,
    unique_materials,
    sort_level,
    LAG(dept_name) OVER (ORDER BY dept_sort, course_sort, sort_level) AS prev_dept,
    LAG(master_course_code) OVER (ORDER BY dept_sort, course_sort, sort_level) AS prev_course
  FROM ordered
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN sort_level = 2 THEN 'Grand Total'
    WHEN sort_level = 1 THEN CONCAT(dept_name, ' Subtotal')
    WHEN prev_dept <=> dept_name THEN NULL
    ELSE dept_name
  END AS department,
  CASE
    WHEN sort_level IN (1,2) THEN NULL
    WHEN prev_dept <=> dept_name AND prev_course <=> master_course_code THEN NULL
    ELSE master_course_code
  END AS master_course_code,
  FORMAT(ROUND(subject_cnt, 0), 0) AS number_of_subjects,
  FORMAT(ROUND(total_new_shelf_price, 0), 0) AS total_new_shelf_price,
  FORMAT(ROUND(unique_materials, 0), 0) AS unique_tip_materials
FROM final
ORDER BY dept_sort, course_sort, sort_level;

WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    c.TERM_CODE AS term_code,
    c.DEPARTMENT_CODE AS department_code,
    c.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS department_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_courses,
    AVG(
      CASE
        WHEN c.EQUIVALENT_SUBJECTS IS NULL OR TRIM(c.EQUIVALENT_SUBJECTS) = '' THEN 0
        ELSE 1 + (LENGTH(c.EQUIVALENT_SUBJECTS) - LENGTH(REPLACE(c.EQUIVALENT_SUBJECTS, ',', '')))
      END
    ) AS avg_equiv_subjects,
    sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name,
    sad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER AS department_phone_number
  FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c
  LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd
    ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE
  LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad
    ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE
  GROUP BY
    c.TERM_CODE, c.DEPARTMENT_CODE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER
),
term_subtotals AS (
  SELECT
    term_code,
    'SUBTOTAL' AS department_name,
    SUM(num_courses) AS num_courses,
    AVG(avg_equiv_subjects) AS avg_equiv_subjects,
    NULL AS school_name,
    NULL AS department_phone_number
  FROM base
  GROUP BY term_code
),
grand_total AS (
  SELECT
    'TOTAL' AS term_code,
    'SUBTOTAL' AS department_name,
    SUM(num_courses) AS num_courses,
    AVG(avg_equiv_subjects) AS avg_equiv_subjects,
    NULL AS school_name,
    NULL AS department_phone_number
  FROM base
),
unioned AS (
  SELECT
    term_code,
    department_name,
    num_courses,
    avg_equiv_subjects,
    school_name,
    department_phone_number,
    0 AS is_subtotal,
    department_name AS dept_sort
  FROM base
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    term_code,
    department_name,
    num_courses,
    avg_equiv_subjects,
    school_name,
    department_phone_number,
    1 AS is_subtotal,
    'ZZZZZZZZ' AS dept_sort
  FROM term_subtotals
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    term_code,
    department_name,
    num_courses,
    avg_equiv_subjects,
    school_name,
    department_phone_number,
    2 AS is_subtotal,
    'ZZZZZZZZ' AS dept_sort
  FROM grand_total
),
ordered AS (
  SELECT
    term_code,
    department_name,
    num_courses,
    avg_equiv_subjects,
    school_name,
    department_phone_number,
    CASE
      WHEN term_code IN ('TOTAL') THEN 'ZZZZZZZZ'
      ELSE term_code
    END AS term_sort,
    is_subtotal,
    dept_sort
  FROM unioned
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN @prev_term = term_code THEN NULL
    ELSE term_code
  END AS term,
  department_name AS department,
  num_courses AS number_of_courses,
  avg_equiv_subjects AS average_number_of_equivalent_subjects,
  school_name,
  department_phone_number,
  @prev_term := term_code AS _term_tracker
FROM (
  SELECT *
  FROM ordered
  ORDER BY
    term_sort,
    is_subtotal,
    dept_sort
) x
CROSS JOIN (SELECT @prev_term := '') vars;

WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    CASE WHEN at.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' THEN 'CURRENT' ELSE 'NOT CURRENT' END AS current_status,
    isc.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME AS session_name,
    iss.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY,
    TIMESTAMPDIFF(
      SECOND,
      STR_TO_DATE(iss.SESSION_START_TIME, '%h%i%p'),
      STR_TO_DATE(iss.SESSION_END_TIME, '%h%i%p')
    ) / 86400.0 AS session_days
  FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL isd
  JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at
    ON isd.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE
  JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION iss
    ON isd.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY = iss.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY
  JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY isc
    ON isd.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = isc.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY
  WHERE iss.SESSION_START_TIME IS NOT NULL
    AND iss.SESSION_END_TIME IS NOT NULL
),
agg AS (
  SELECT
    current_status,
    session_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY) AS iap_sessions,
    SUM(session_days) AS total_session_days,
    AVG(session_days) AS avg_session_days
  FROM base
  GROUP BY current_status, session_name
),
final_rows AS (
  SELECT
    current_status,
    session_name,
    iap_sessions,
    total_session_days,
    avg_session_days,
    1 AS cluster_type_sort,
    'DETAIL' AS cluster_type
  FROM agg

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    current_status,
    'SUBTOTAL' AS session_name,
    SUM(iap_sessions) AS iap_sessions,
    SUM(total_session_days) AS total_session_days,
    SUM(total_session_days) / NULLIF(SUM(iap_sessions), 0) AS avg_session_days,
    2 AS cluster_type_sort,
    'SUBTOTAL' AS cluster_type
  FROM agg
  GROUP BY current_status

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    'GRAND TOTAL' AS current_status,
    'GRAND TOTAL' AS session_name,
    SUM(iap_sessions) AS iap_sessions,
    SUM(total_session_days) AS total_session_days,
    SUM(total_session_days) / NULLIF(SUM(iap_sessions), 0) AS avg_session_days,
    3 AS cluster_type_sort,
    'GRAND TOTAL' AS cluster_type
  FROM agg
),
ordered AS (
  SELECT
    current_status,
    session_name,
    iap_sessions,
    total_session_days,
    avg_session_days,
    cluster_type_sort,
    cluster_type,
    CASE
      WHEN current_status = LAG(current_status) OVER (ORDER BY (current_status = 'NOT CURRENT'), current_status, cluster_type_sort, session_name)
      THEN NULL
      ELSE current_status
    END AS current_status_display
  FROM final_rows
)
SELECT
  current_status_display AS current_status,
  cluster_type,
  session_name,
  iap_sessions,
  total_session_days,
  avg_session_days
FROM ordered
ORDER BY
  (current_status = 'NOT CURRENT'),
  current_status,
  cluster_type_sort,
  session_name;

WITH term_new_subjects AS (
  SELECT
    at.ACADEMIC_YEAR,
    at.TERM_CODE,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS new_subjects
  FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL at
  JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c
    ON c.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE
  WHERE c.STATUS_CHANGE LIKE 'New%'
  GROUP BY
    at.ACADEMIC_YEAR,
    at.TERM_CODE
),
detail AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN ACADEMIC_YEAR = LAG(ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, TERM_CODE) THEN NULL
      ELSE ACADEMIC_YEAR
    END AS academic_year_display,
    TERM_CODE,
    new_subjects,
    0 AS is_total
  FROM term_new_subjects
),
total_row AS (
  SELECT
    'TOTAL' AS academic_year_display,
    NULL AS TERM_CODE,
    SUM(new_subjects) AS new_subjects,
    1 AS is_total
  FROM term_new_subjects
)
SELECT
  academic_year_display AS ACADEMIC_YEAR,
  TERM_CODE,
  new_subjects AS NEWLY_INTRODUCED_SUBJECTS
FROM (
  SELECT * FROM detail
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM total_row
) x
ORDER BY
  is_total,
  COALESCE(ACADEMIC_YEAR, '9999'),
  TERM_CODE;

SELECT
  ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME AS list_name,
  mlo.OWNER AS owner,
  COUNT(DISTINCT mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER) AS member_count
FROM MOIRA_LIST ml
JOIN MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL mld
  ON mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
JOIN MOIRA_LIST_OWNER mlo
  ON mlo.MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY = mld.MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY
LEFT JOIN SE_PERSON sp
  ON sp.KRB_NAME = mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER
LEFT JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd
  ON msd.FULL_NAME = sp.FULL_NAME
GROUP BY
  ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
  ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
  mlo.OWNER
HAVING
  LOWER(ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME) LIKE 'e%'
  AND COUNT(DISTINCT mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER) BETWEEN 10 AND 20
  AND (
    SUM(CASE WHEN msd.DEPARTMENT = '6' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(DISTINCT mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER)
  ) > 0.75;

WITH list_sizes AS (
  SELECT
    mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
    COUNT(*) AS list_size
  FROM MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL mld
  GROUP BY mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
),
student_lists AS (
  SELECT
    msd.FULL_NAME,
    mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
  FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd
  JOIN SE_PERSON sp
    ON sp.FULL_NAME = msd.FULL_NAME
  JOIN MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL mld
    ON mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID = sp.MIT_ID
  JOIN MOIRA_LIST ml
    ON ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
  WHERE ml.IS_MOIRA_MAILING_LIST = 'Y'
)
SELECT
  msd.FULL_NAME AS student_name,
  sad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER AS department_phone_number,
  COUNT(DISTINCT sl.MOIRA_LIST_KEY) AS total_mailing_lists,
  AVG(ls.list_size) AS avg_mailing_list_size
FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd
JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd
  ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT
JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad
  ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE
LEFT JOIN student_lists sl
  ON sl.FULL_NAME = msd.FULL_NAME
LEFT JOIN list_sizes ls
  ON ls.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = sl.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
WHERE msd.LAST_NAME LIKE 'K%'
GROUP BY
  msd.FULL_NAME,
  sad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER
ORDER BY
  msd.FULL_NAME;

WITH top_lists AS (
  SELECT
    ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
    ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
    ml.IS_PUBLIC,
    COUNT(mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER) AS total_subscribers
  FROM MOIRA_LIST ml
  JOIN MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL mld
    ON mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
  WHERE ml.IS_MOIRA_MAILING_LIST = 'Y'
    AND ml.IS_ACTIVE = 'Y'
  GROUP BY ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY, ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME, ml.IS_PUBLIC
  ORDER BY total_subscribers DESC
  LIMIT 100
),
dept_counts AS (
  SELECT
    tl.MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
    msd.DEPARTMENT AS DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    COUNT(*) AS dept_student_count
  FROM top_lists tl
  JOIN MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL mld
    ON mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = tl.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
  JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd
    ON msd.FULL_NAME = mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_FULL_NAME
  GROUP BY tl.MOIRA_LIST_KEY, msd.DEPARTMENT
),
dept_ranked AS (
  SELECT
    dc.*,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY dc.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
      ORDER BY dc.dept_student_count DESC, dc.DEPARTMENT_CODE
    ) AS rn
  FROM dept_counts dc
)
SELECT
  tl.MOIRA_LIST_NAME AS list_name,
  tl.total_subscribers,
  tl.IS_PUBLIC AS public_status,
  sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS top_department_name,
  dr.dept_student_count AS top_department_student_count
FROM top_lists tl
LEFT JOIN dept_ranked dr
  ON dr.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = tl.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
 AND dr.rn = 1
LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd
  ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dr.DEPARTMENT_CODE
ORDER BY tl.total_subscribers DESC, tl.MOIRA_LIST_NAME;

SELECT
  b.BUILDING_NAME AS building_name,
  b.BUILDING_NUMBER AS building_number,
  COALESCE(f.total_assignable_area, 0) AS total_assignable_area,
  COALESCE(f.total_non_assignable_area, 0) AS total_non_assignable_area,
  COALESCE(r.total_room_count, 0) AS total_room_count
FROM FAC_BUILDING b
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    BUILDING_KEY,
    SUM(COALESCE(ASSIGNABLE_AREA, 0)) AS total_assignable_area,
    SUM(COALESCE(NON_ASSIGNABLE_AREA, 0)) AS total_non_assignable_area
  FROM FAC_FLOOR
  GROUP BY BUILDING_KEY
) f
  ON f.BUILDING_KEY = b.FAC_BUILDING_KEY
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    BUILDING_KEY,
    COUNT(DISTINCT FAC_ROOM_KEY) AS total_room_count
  FROM FAC_ROOMS
  GROUP BY BUILDING_KEY
) r
  ON r.BUILDING_KEY = b.FAC_BUILDING_KEY
ORDER BY total_assignable_area DESC;

SELECT
  r.FAC_ROOM_KEY,
  r.ROOM_FULL_NAME,
  r.AREA,
  mu.MAJOR_USE,
  org.ORGANIZATION_NAME,
  COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY r.MAJOR_USE_KEY) AS rooms_per_major_use,
  SUM(CAST(r.AREA AS DECIMAL(18,2))) OVER (PARTITION BY r.ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS total_area_per_organization
FROM FAC_ROOMS r
LEFT JOIN FAC_MAJOR_USE mu
  ON r.MAJOR_USE_KEY = mu.MAJOR_USE_KEY
LEFT JOIN FAC_ORGANIZATION org
  ON r.ORGANIZATION_KEY = org.ORGANIZATION_KEY
WHERE r.BUILDING_KEY = '45'
ORDER BY r.FLOOR, r.ROOM;

SELECT
    b.BUILDING_NAME AS building_name,
    b.BUILDING_NUMBER AS building_number,
    b.DATE_BUILT AS construction_date,
    b.BUILDING_TYPE AS building_type,
    COALESCE(a.address_count, 0) AS address_count,
    AVG(CAST(b.EXT_GROSS_AREA AS DECIMAL(18,2))) AS avg_gross_area,
    COALESCE(r.room_count, 0) AS total_rooms
FROM FAC_BUILDING b
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        BUILDING_KEY,
        COUNT(BUILDING_ADDRESS_KEY) AS address_count
    FROM FAC_BUILDING_ADDRESS
    GROUP BY BUILDING_KEY
) a
    ON a.BUILDING_KEY = b.FAC_BUILDING_KEY
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        BUILDING_KEY,
        COUNT(FAC_ROOM_KEY) AS room_count
    FROM FAC_ROOMS
    GROUP BY BUILDING_KEY
) r
    ON r.BUILDING_KEY = b.FAC_BUILDING_KEY
GROUP BY
    b.FAC_BUILDING_KEY,
    b.BUILDING_NAME,
    b.BUILDING_NUMBER,
    b.DATE_BUILT,
    b.BUILDING_TYPE,
    a.address_count,
    r.room_count
ORDER BY
    b.BUILDING_NAME;

SELECT
  lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT lso.MASTER_COURSE_NUMBER) AS unique_courses_offered,
  COUNT(DISTINCT lrc.CATALOG_TITLE) AS unique_reserved_materials,
  COUNT(DISTINCT lci.INSTRUCTOR_NAME) AS unique_instructors
FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso
LEFT JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrmd
  ON lrmd.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = lso.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
LEFT JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG AS lrc
  ON lrc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY
LEFT JOIN LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR AS lci
  ON lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY
GROUP BY
  lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME
ORDER BY
  unique_courses_offered DESC,
  department_name;

SELECT
  lso.SUBJECT_TITLE AS title,
  COUNT(lrrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS total_reserved_materials,
  COUNT(DISTINCT lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS) AS distinct_material_status_count
FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrrmd
JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso
  ON lrrmd.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = lso.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
JOIN LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS lms
  ON lrrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY
GROUP BY lso.SUBJECT_TITLE
ORDER BY total_reserved_materials DESC;

SELECT
  lci.INSTRUCTOR_NAME AS instructor_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT lci.COURSE_NAME) AS unique_courses_taught,
  COUNT(lrmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY) AS total_material_assignments,
  AVG(NULLIF(CAST(lrc.CATALOG_YEAR AS UNSIGNED), 0)) AS avg_publication_year,
  COUNT(DISTINCT lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS) AS distinct_status_count
FROM LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR lci
LEFT JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrmd
  ON lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY
LEFT JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG lrc
  ON lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = lrc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY
LEFT JOIN LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS lms
  ON lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY
GROUP BY
  lci.INSTRUCTOR_NAME
ORDER BY
  unique_courses_taught DESC;

SELECT
  rc.CATALOG_YEAR AS publication_year,
  COUNT(DISTINCT rc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS total_reserved_materials,
  AVG(CHAR_LENGTH(rc.CATALOG_TITLE)) AS avg_title_length,
  COUNT(DISTINCT ms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS) AS distinct_status_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT ci.COURSE_NAME) AS course_count
FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL rmd
JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG rc
  ON rc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = rmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY
JOIN LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS ms
  ON ms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = rmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY
JOIN LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR ci
  ON ci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = rmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY
GROUP BY rc.CATALOG_YEAR
ORDER BY rc.CATALOG_YEAR DESC;

SELECT
  c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME AS category_name,
  s.SPONSOR_NAME AS sponsor_name,
  COUNT(*) AS activities_offered,
  AVG(d.FEE) AS avg_fee_per_activity
FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d
JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY c
  ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY
JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR s
  ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY = s.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY
GROUP BY
  c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME,
  s.SPONSOR_NAME
ORDER BY
  activities_offered DESC;

SELECT
  s.SPONSOR_NAME AS sponsor_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT sess.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY) AS sessions_hosted,
  COUNT(DISTINCT d.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY) AS unique_subjects_organized
FROM IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR s
LEFT JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d
  ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY = s.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY
LEFT JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION sess
  ON sess.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY = d.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY
GROUP BY s.SPONSOR_NAME
ORDER BY s.SPONSOR_NAME;

SELECT
  p.PERSON_ROLE AS role,
  c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME AS category_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT p.IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY) AS role_count,
  AVG(d.FEE) AS avg_fee
FROM IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON p
JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d
  ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY = p.IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY
JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY c
  ON c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY
GROUP BY
  p.PERSON_ROLE,
  c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME
ORDER BY
  role_count DESC;

WITH floor_counts AS (
  SELECT
    b.FAC_BUILDING_KEY,
    b.BUILDING_NAME,
    COUNT(DISTINCT f.LEVEL_ID) AS floor_count
  FROM FAC_BUILDING b
  JOIN FAC_ROOMS r
    ON r.BUILDING_KEY = b.FAC_BUILDING_KEY
  JOIN FAC_FLOOR f
    ON f.FLOOR_KEY = r.FLOOR_KEY
  GROUP BY b.FAC_BUILDING_KEY, b.BUILDING_NAME
),
max_count AS (
  SELECT MAX(floor_count) AS max_floor_count
  FROM floor_counts
)
SELECT fc.BUILDING_NAME
FROM floor_counts fc
JOIN max_count mc
  ON fc.floor_count = mc.max_floor_count;

SELECT
  c.SUBJECT_TITLE AS subject_title,
  COUNT(DISTINCT e.MIT_ID) AS number_of_instructors,
  MAX(CHAR_LENGTH(e.FULL_NAME)) AS longest_instructor_name_length
FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c
JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t
  ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE
JOIN EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY e
  ON c.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID = e.MIT_ID
WHERE c.IS_OFFERED_SUMMER_TERM = 'Y'
GROUP BY c.SUBJECT_TITLE
ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_TITLE;

SELECT
  o.OWNER AS owner,
  COUNT(DISTINCT l.MOIRA_LIST_KEY) AS total_mailing_lists,
  COUNT(d.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER) AS total_members
FROM MOIRA_LIST_OWNER o
JOIN MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL d
  ON d.MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY = o.MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY
JOIN MOIRA_LIST l
  ON l.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = d.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
WHERE o.MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY = 'LIST69.377-keeper-xenon'
  AND l.IS_MOIRA_MAILING_LIST = 'Y'
GROUP BY o.OWNER;

SELECT
  d.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT cd.COURSE) AS total_courses_in_subject_catalog,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN cd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' THEN cd.COURSE END) AS total_degree_granting_courses_in_subject_catalog
FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION cd
JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d
  ON cd.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE
JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc
  ON cd.COURSE = sc.COURSE_NUMBER
GROUP BY d.SCHOOL_NAME
ORDER BY d.SCHOOL_NAME;

SELECT
  d.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS department_name,
  ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER AS department_phone_number,
  COUNT(msd.EMAIL_ADDRESS) AS number_of_students,
  MAX(CHAR_LENGTH(msd.FULL_NAME)) AS longest_student_full_name_length
FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d
LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad
  ON ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE
LEFT JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd
  ON msd.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE
GROUP BY
  d.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
  d.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER
ORDER BY
  d.DEPARTMENT_NAME;
